wilds.name: Going Bananas
wilds.behavior:
When the Going Bananas feature triggers, Kong throws 1 to 5 wild barrels to random positions on the reels that reveal a random multiplier when they land. There are 3 tiers of barrels: Low, Medium and High.

 Low tier barrels can have the values: WILD, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x.

 Medium tier barrels can have the values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 35x, 40x, 45x, 50x.

 High tier barrels can have the values: 30x, 40x, 50x, 75x, 100x.

 If a barrel lands on another barrel already present on the reels, it bounces and duplicates so that two barrels fly to new spots on the reel. If either of those barrels hit another barrel, it repeats until all barrels land on a space that is not occupied by another barrel.

wilds.behavior:

Each spin in the bonus game will have a Wild Multiplier equal to the Global Multiplier appear on one randomly selected reel, unless the Blademaster feature activates. wilds.name: EXPANDING WILD TRIDENTS
wilds.behavior:
When a Trident symbol lands it will expand to cover the whole reel, if the expanded symbol would be part of at least one winning combination after expanding.

 Trident symbols and expanded Tridents substitute for all other symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: MYSTERY GATES
scatters.behavior:
Mystery Gates are full-sized revealing symbols that show either one of the regular paying symbols or a Golden Chest.

 If a Mystery Gate symbol lands partially outside of the game view, it will nudge into view so that it fully covers the reel.

 If at least 3 Mystery Gates land at the same time, the revealed symbols will be treated as if they were connected from left to right and therefore create winning combinations even if there are other non-winning symbols between them. When 3 or more Mystery Gates have revealed their symbols, if there is more than one winning combination on the same payline, for example by having separate wins that includes symbols revealed by Mystery Gates and symbols which were not revealed, the longest winning combination will be selected. If the length is the same, the win created by revealed symbols will be used.

 All Mystery Gates reveal the same symbol. Mystery Gates cannot reveal Trident symbols or BONUS symbols.

multipliers.name: POSEIDON'S TREASURE
multipliers.behavior:
This feature occurs when Mystery Gates reveal Golden Chest symbols. At the start of the feature, all Golden Chests open and each position spins to reveal either a Bronze, Silver or Gold Coin, a Multiplier symbol or a Gather symbol.

 Coins are cash prizes based on your current bet that show a value from 1 to 1000.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 5

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 10

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 100, 250, 500, 1000

 The Multiplier symbol reveals a multiplier value that can be 2x, 3x, 5x or 10x. This value is then applied to all Coins and Gather symbols.

 The Gather symbol gathers the value of all Coins and other Gather symbols. After gathering, another spin reveal occurs on each position except activated Gather symbols so that new Coins, Gather symbols or Multiplier symbols can appear. The Gather symbol will take on the total value of all gathered Coins and other Gather symbols. Each Gather symbol cannot activate more than once.

 At the end of the feature, the value of all Coins and Gather symbols will be added together and the total value will be multiplied by your bet to determine the final awarded win.

modes.trigger: landing 3, 4 or 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
The bonus feature is triggered by landing 3, 4 or 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 3 BONUS symbols award 10 free spins.

 4 BONUS symbols award 12 free spins.

 5 BONUS symbols award 14 free spins.

 In this feature all Mystery Gates are sticky for the remainder of the bonus after landing.

 Above each reel is a Reel Multiplier that starts inactive at 0x. When a Golden Temple symbol lands on a reel, the Reel Multiplier is increased by the value shown on the symbol.

 Golden Temple symbols can have one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x

 When a Reel Multiplier is no longer at 0x it is activated.

 All winning combinations are multiplied by the values of the activated Reel Multipliers above each reel that is included in the win. If more than one activated Reel Multipliers would be applied to a win, their values are added together before multiplying the winning amount.

 Reel Multipliers are also applied to all Coins and Gather symbols in the Poseidon’s Treasure feature before summing the total value.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
The Diamond Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 The Diamond Wild symbol becomes sticky when landing and does not tumble. If it participates in any winning combinations its multiplier doubles up to 2048x.

 The Diamond Wild symbol lands with a 1x initial multiplier, except in the Pursuit of Diamonds bonus, where all Diamond Wild symbols land with a 2x initial multiplier.

 A maximum of 5 Diamond Wild symbols can be present on the grid at the same time.

 If more than one Diamond Wild symbols with multipliers participate in the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior: The Wild symbol substitutes for all High & Low Symbols and can have multipliers attached to them by Gold and Green Dragons. Wild Multipliers multiply all connected paylines, and if multiple Wild Multipliers appear on the same payline, their values are added together before being applied to the win. In the bonus, all Wilds and Red Dragon Wild reels become sticky until the end of the bonus game.

wilds.name: RED DRAGON
wilds.behavior: The Red Dragon expands into a full Wild reel, revealing a multiplier that can be x2, x3, x5, x10, x25, x50, or x100. It can land in both the base and bonus games.

wilds.name: BLUE DRAGON
wilds.behavior: The Blue Dragon breathes fire in one of four directions (left, right, up, down), transforming regular symbols into Wild Symbols. The Blue Dragon then transforms into a Wild symbol itself. It can land in both the base and bonus games.

wilds.name: GREEN DRAGON
wilds.behavior: The Green Dragon reveals a multiplier and adds it to all Wilds and Wild reels on the grid. The multiplier can be x2, x3, x5, x10, x25, x50, or x100. The Green Dragon can only land in the bonus game and cannot land if no Wild symbols or Wild reels are present on the grid.

wilds.name: GOLD DRAGON
wilds.behavior: The Gold Dragon shoots a random number of golden fireballs (minimum 1, maximum 5) at Wilds or Wild reels and doubles their multipliers. It can target the same or different symbols with each shot. The Gold Dragon can only land in the bonus game and cannot land if no Wild symbols or Wild reels are present on the grid.

modes.name: BONUS

modes.effects:

 In the bonus game there is a higher chance of landing Red and Blue Dragons than in the base game. You may also be fortunate enough to see a Green or Gold Dragon!

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Before each spin, up to 5 multipliers can appear in random positions behind the grid, with at least 1 guaranteed in bonus games. If a winning combination lands on a multiplier, it’s removed from the grid and collected into the cannon beside the grid, adding to any multiplier already stored.

 The multipliers can have one of the following values: 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x, 512x or 1024x.

 If there is a Cannon symbol on the grid it will activate and apply the multiplier stored in the cannon to the Tumble win.

 The Cannon symbol activates only if there is a winning combination and a stored multiplier in the cannon beside the grid.

 If no Cannon symbols activate, all stored multipliers are lost and reset at the start of the next spin - except when they are persistent in the bonus games.

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 A win is formed by the sum of collected values from cash prizes multiplied by your bet amount.

scatters.name: SHIELD SYMBOL
scatters.behavior:
The Shield symbols reveal Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins and have a chance of revealing Multiplier, Collector or BONUS symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5, 10, 25, 50

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 100, 250, 500, 1000

 After all Coins and special symbols have been revealed, empty Collector symbols will activate and collect the values of all Coins and store their total value. Collector symbols don’t collect the values of other Collector symbols. Collected Coins will transform into Shield symbols again and reveal new Coins or special symbols. This process repeats until no empty Collector symbols are available on the grid.

 After all Coins and Collector symbols have been revealed and collected, the Multiplier symbols will activate and multiply all Coins and Collector symbols with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 At the end of the spin all Coins and Collector symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

scatters.name: DEATH OR GLORY Bonus
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the DEATH OR GLORY bonus by landing 3 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Shield symbols become sticky and reveal new Coins, Multiplier or Collector symbols on each spin. BONUS symbols are not available during this bonus.

 The bonus has 3 refilling lives that reset every time a new Shield symbol lands. Each life represents one spin. Once all 3 lives are consumed without a new reset, the Bonus ends.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Gladius: Death or Glory is a 5-reel, 5-row game that throws you into the heart of the arena, where only the strongest survive. Wins are awarded by collecting coins which multiply your bet. Watch for the Shield Symbol, which unlocks powerful wins! Will you seize glory or fall in battle? The arena awaits!

 The maximum win in this game is 15,000 times your bet and can be achieved in all game modes.

 FEATURES

 SHIELD SYMBOL

 The Shield symbols reveal Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins and have a chance of revealing Multiplier, Collector or BONUS symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes

respins.how_it_works:
When the Eye symbol is revealed by the Mystery Gates they open and can reveal Coins, +FS or Collector symbols.

 +FS symbols can only be revealed during the bonus games and grant their value as additional free spins. They can come with values of +1, +2 or +3.

 All cash prizes are paid as a multiple of your bet and are added to your win for the spin. They come in 3 tiers:

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1x, 2x, 5x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 100x, 250x, 500x, 1000x

 The Collector symbol collects all cash prizes and the values of other Collector symbols on the screen before respinning only the cash prize positions. Collected Collector symbols keep their initial value.

wilds.name: MYSTERY NUDGE GATES
wilds.behavior:
Mystery Gates are 4-height symbols that can land partially outside the reels and then nudge up or down until they cover the full reel. Mystery Gates can land anywhere on the grid. When this happens the global multiplier increases by +1. Gates move up or down (1 tile at a time) in order to cover their entire reel in the fastest way possible. Every time a Mystery Gate nudges up or down the global multiplier increases by +1. After a gate covers its entire reel it opens to reveal any type of paying symbol, Wild symbols or Eye symbols. Eye symbols reveal coins and special symbols.

 Multiple gates at the same time always reveal the same type of symbol.

wilds.name: ODIN’S TRIAL
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Odin's Trial bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Base game mechanics are followed with an increased chance to land Mystery Gates. In addition the Mystery Gates become sticky and reveal paying symbols, Wild symbols or Eye symbols on each spin. The global multiplier is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.

 Additional +1, +2 or +3 free spins can be awarded by revealing the +FS symbol from the coin feature.

wilds.name: FURY OF THE GODS
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Fury of the Gods bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Base game mechanics are followed with an increased chance to land Mystery Gates. In addition the Mystery Gates become sticky and reveal high paying symbols, Wild symbols or Eye symbols on each spin. The global multiplier is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.

 Additional +1, +2 or +3 free spins can be awarded by revealing the +FS symbol from the coin feature.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOL
wilds.behavior: The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
multipliers.behavior:
The Global multiplier starts at 1x. Every time a Mystery gate lands the global multiplier increases by +1. When a gate nudges up or down the global multiplier also increases by +1. During the bonus games it is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.

 At the end of the spin the values of all coins and Collector symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final cash prize, which will be added to the Total Win.

modes.effects:
Landing at least 3 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game activates the Bonus Feature.

 3 BONUS symbols award 12 free spins.

 4 BONUS symbols award 14 free spins.

multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted.

 If there is a Cannon symbol on the grid it will activate any highlighted squares after winning combinations have been awarded.

 The Cannon symbol activates only if there have been winning combinations in the current spin.

 When activated, squares will reveal Multiplier Bomb symbols and possibly the special R-Bomb. All Multiplier Bombs will then explode and reveal a multiplier which is added to a total multiplier one by one from left to right, top to bottom.

 Multiplier Bombs can either be additive or multiplicative. Additive Bombs add their value to the total multiplier, while multiplicative Bombs multiply the value of the total multiplier.

 There are three different regular Multiplier Bombs and a special Golden Multiplier Bomb:

multipliers.name: Golden Multiplier Bomb
multipliers.behavior:
Golden Multiplier Bombs are multiplicative and can have one of the following multipliers: x2, x3, x5 or x10.

 After all Multiplier Bombs have been revealed, if the special R-Bomb has been revealed, it will first collect all additive multipliers to the total win bar before replacing those positions with new bombs. New bombs may be of any type (additive, multiplicative or possibly another R-Bomb). The R-Bomb is also replaced with a new bomb. Golden Multiplier Bombs are not replaced and remain until the end.

 Only 1 R-Bomb can be present on the grid at a time.

 Once all Bombs are revealed, the Golden Multiplier Bombs reveal their multipliers, further multiplying the total collected multiplier.

 At the end the total multiplier amount will be used to multiply the value of the Tumble Win and the new Tumble Win value is then awarded.

 Purple lollipop: 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x.

 Red lollipop: 100x, 250x, 500x, 1000x.

 The multiplier revealed is then added to the reel multiplier below the reel the Lollipop symbol landed on.

 The reel multipliers apply to all wins that have at least one winning symbol on that reel. If a winning connection has symbols from multiple reels with a multiplier, these multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: NINJA REELS
wilds.behavior:
Above and below the main grid there are 2 additional Ninja Reels to enhance your gameplay. When unlocked, these Ninja Reels can introduce random elements to the game by revealing Wild, MultiSplit, or +FS symbols. Apart from these special symbols, the other symbols on the Ninja Reels are non-paying dead symbols.

 In the BASE GAME both Ninja Reels are locked at the start of each spin, and are unlocked if any of the three different BONUS symbols lands on the main grid.

 In THE MYSTERIES OF THE DOJO and THE SECRETS OF THE SCROLL both Ninja Reels are always fully unlocked.

 In THE WISDOM OF THE KOI the bottom Ninja Reel is locked and each position on it must be individually unlocked, and the top Ninja Reel is replaced with reel multipliers.

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
When a Wild symbol lands on one of the Ninja Reels it will create a new Wild symbol in a random position on the corresponding reel in the main grid.

 Wild symbols that land or are created on the main grid have a chance to get one of the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x.

 If more than one Wild multiplier symbols are part of the same winning combination, their multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: MULTISPLIT SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
MultiSplit symbols only appear Ninja Reels, and when one of these symbols lands it will multiply the multiplier value of all Wild symbols on the corresponding reel in the main grid with the displayed multiplier.

 The possible MultiSplit multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x.

 If a MultiSplit symbol crosses over a Wild that does not have a multiplier value, the multiplier value of the MultiSplit will be added to the Wild.

wilds.name: COLLECTION PHASE
wilds.behavior:
The goal of the Collection Phase is to collect as many wilds and reel multipliers as possible, and unlock slots in the bottom Ninja Reel to be able to get MultiSplit symbols in the Payout Phase!

 In the Collection Phase starts you have 3 lives and the game transforms so that only non-winning, Wild, multiplier and MultiSplit symbols appear on the main grid. Lives get reset whenever a Wild, multiplier or MultiSplit symbol lands. The Collection Phase continues until you get 3 non-winning spins in a row.

 These are the non-winning symbols in the Collection Phase:

 Above each reel is a reel multiplier that starts at 1x. By landing multiplier symbols, the reel multipliers above the main reels are progressively increased!

 Below the main grid there is a Ninja Reel which is initially locked. Each position in the Ninja Reel can be unlocked for the Payout Phase by landing a MultiSplit symbol on the corresponding reel in the main grid.

wilds.name: PAYOUT PHASE
wilds.behavior:
After the Collection Phase, 3 final free spins will be awarded for the Payout Phase.

 All collected wilds will land randomly on the main grid on each spin. Each Wild will have a multiplier value corresponding to the reel multiplier above the reel where it lands.

 The unlocked positions on the bottom Ninja Reel can also reveal MultiSplit symbols to boost the multipliers of the Wild symbols!

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The DOJO BONUS, SCROLL BONUS and KOI BONUS symbols do not appear during any bonus game.

 Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable and appear in all game modes. Wild symbols do not appear on Ninja Reels in THE WISDOM OF THE KOI bonus game.

specials.name: +FS SYMBOL
specials.behavior: During THE MYSTERIES OF THE DOJO and THE SECRETS OF THE SCROLL bonus games you can land +FS symbols in either of the two Ninja Reels, granting an additional 1-3 free spins per symbol.

scatters.name: TRACTOR FEATURE
scatters.behavior:
If a Farmer symbol or a Gold Farmer symbol lands in the grid but no Dirt symbols land at the same time, there is a chance to trigger the Tractor feature. The Tractor feature will plow the field and remove all symbols except any Bonus symbols and Farmer/Gold Farmer symbols that were already present in the grid. The Tractor will leave 1 - 10 Dirt symbols behind it, which will activate the Dig feature.

 The Tractor feature is present in both the base game and the bonus game.

specials.name: DIG FEATURE
specials.behavior:
When at least one Farmer symbol and at least one Dirt symbol land at the same time, the Farmer digs up the Dirt! A Coin with one of the possible values 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x, 1000x will be uncovered and added to the Farmer symbol.

 One Farmer symbol per reel can land at the same time. If multiple Farmer symbols land each Farmer will dig up each Dirt symbol one time.

 When all Dirt symbols have been dug up, all Farmer symbol values will be added together and finally multiply the player’s bet to form the payout.

grid.layout_notes: Official Game Description: 6 rows and 5-to-6 columns slot with an offset symbol grid. Columns vary between 5 and 6; cols recorded as 6 (upper bound) because schema has no cols_min/cols_max.

win_system.notes: A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected. Only the largest cluster of the connected identical symbols is paid out. Varying number of ways to win.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Avalanche: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols that were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. Continues as long as new winning combinations appear. Symbols drop vertically with gravity and slide to the left and right repeatedly as far downwards as possible. All symbols except wild symbols can fall through wild symbols.

other.name: Offset gravity drop
other.how_it_works: Symbols drop vertically with gravity and slide left and right repeatedly as far downwards as possible on the offset grid. Non-wild symbols can fall through Multiplier Wilds.

wilds.name: Multiplier Wild
wilds.behavior: Substitutes for any symbol except bonus and burst. Created at x1 in a vacant position after a winning cluster of solely payout symbols (not coins). Increases multiplier by 1 for each winning cluster it is part of, then moves to a vacant position created by removing winning symbols. Multiple Multiplier Wilds in the same cluster: values are added, then the sum multiplies the cluster win. After the win, individual multipliers increase before being multiplied and merged into a new Multiplier Wild.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: A bonus symbol that reaches the bonus key mould below the game grid triggers the bonus game with 7 free drops. Reaching a super bonus key mould triggers the super bonus game with 7 free drops. During bonus/super bonus, reaching a mould awards +3 free drops and upgrades to super bonus if a super bonus key mould is reached.

params.trigger_condition: reaches bonus key mould below grid

multipliers.name: Multiplier Wild
multipliers.behavior: Same symbol as wilds: carries an integer multiplier that starts at x1 and increases by 1 per winning cluster participation. Additive across Multiplier Wilds in one cluster, then that sum multiplies the win.

specials.name: Coin
specials.behavior: Coins show a value that is x times the bet. A cluster of coins pays out its aggregate value; that value is then given to a new coin left behind when the cluster is removed. A cluster of solely coin symbols does not create a Multiplier Wild. Multiplier Wilds in a winning coin cluster add their values; the sum multiplies the coin cluster win.

specials.name: Burst
specials.behavior: Blocker activated at the end of the game round when nothing else can happen. Transforms itself and adjacent symbols into the same payout symbol or into coins (individual coin values possible); does not transform into wild. Coins, bonus, burst, and Multiplier Wild symbols are not affected. Adjacent bursts chain so all affected symbols turn into the same payout symbol or coins. Multiple bursts activate simultaneously but act individually. Activates before bonus starts if a bonus trigger is in the same drop; during bonus, activates before awarding additional free drops if another bonus trigger happens in the same free drop.

params.activation: end of round when nothing else can happen

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin drops symbols onto a 6-row, 5-to-6-column offset grid. Cluster wins (≥5 identical symbols connected horizontally or vertically) are collected; winners explode; remaining symbols fall with gravity (sliding L/R; non-wilds fall through wilds); new symbols drop in (Avalanche) until no new wins. Payout-only winning clusters leave an x1 Multiplier Wild; Multiplier Wilds grow, add, multiply, and merge. Coin clusters pay aggregate and leave a new coin (no MW). When nothing else can happen, Burst may transform itself+adjacents. If a bonus symbol reaches a key mould below the grid, Bonus or Super Bonus (7 free drops) starts after Burst (if any). Round ends immediately if 10,000x win cap is reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet (€0.20–€100; each bet is 100 coins) and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Game round starts on the selected bet level. No bets can be changed during an ongoing round. Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop
phases.what_happens: Symbols drop onto the offset grid with gravity, sliding left/right as far down as possible. Non-wild symbols can fall through Multiplier Wilds. (X-iter Coin Burst: Burst present in first drop and bursts always give coins. X-iter Wild Concoction: drop starts with a number of Multiplier Wilds.)
phases.state_changes: Grid filled

phases.name: Evaluate clusters
phases.what_happens: Find clusters of ≥5 identical symbols connected vertically or horizontally. Only the largest cluster of connected identical symbols is paid. Collect all cluster wins for the current drop.
phases.ends_when: All current-drop cluster wins collected (or none found)
phases.state_changes: Win amounts staged for this drop

phases.name: Apply Multiplier Wild math and create/merge MWs
phases.what_happens: For each winning cluster involving Multiplier Wilds: add MW multipliers in that cluster, then multiply the cluster win by the sum. After the win, increase each participating MW by 1, then multiply/merge them into a new Multiplier Wild in a vacant position. A winning cluster of solely payout symbols (not coins) creates a new x1 Multiplier Wild in a vacant position. Coin-only clusters do not create a Multiplier Wild; coin cluster pays aggregate value and leaves a new coin with that aggregate; MWs in a coin cluster add then multiply the coin win.
phases.ends_when: MW and coin leave-behinds resolved for this drop
phases.state_changes: New/merged Multiplier Wilds and/or new coins placed in vacant positions

phases.name: Explode winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: All symbols that were part of a winning combination explode/are removed. Remaining symbols fall vertically to resting positions; new symbols drop in to fill empty spaces. Return to Evaluate clusters while new winning combinations appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: Burst resolution
phases.what_happens: If Burst symbols remain when nothing else can happen: each Burst activates (simultaneously if multiple, acting individually). Transforms itself and adjacent symbols into the same payout symbol or coins (not wild). Does not affect coins, bonus, burst, or Multiplier Wilds. Adjacent Bursts chain. After transformations, if new clusters form, resume Avalanche loop. If a bonus trigger exists in the same drop, Burst performs before the bonus starts.
phases.ends_when: No Burst left to activate, or post-Burst avalanches finished
phases.state_changes: Transformed symbols; possible new avalanche wins

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If a bonus symbol reached a bonus key mould below the grid: start Bonus with 7 free drops (Multiplier Wilds sticky). If it reached a super bonus key mould: start Super Bonus with 7 free drops (coins and Multiplier Wilds sticky). X-iter Super Bonus / Bonus guarantee entry. Otherwise end round and pay base-game wins (subject to 10,000x cap).
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Cluster wins collected each drop before explode/avalanche. Multiplier Wilds in a cluster add then multiply that cluster. Coin clusters pay aggregate (then leave a new coin). Bonus/super bonus wins are paid out at the end of the bonus mode. Entire round (including bonus) capped at 10,000x bet; round ends immediately when win cap reached and wins so far are paid.
base_game_loop.notes: Ryze is played in two modes: normal mode and bonus mode with free drops. Hit frequency 27.4%. Theoretical RTP 94.0% (base and all X-iter modes).

modes.name: Bonus
modes.trigger: A bonus symbol reaches the bonus key mould below the game grid (or X-iter Bonus buy: guaranteed entry at 100x bet).
modes.retrigger: 3 additional free drops when a bonus symbol reaches a bonus key mould during the bonus game. If a super bonus key mould is reached, the bonus is upgraded to Super Bonus.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Multiplier Wilds are sticky between free drops.
modes.progressive_state: May upgrade to Super Bonus if a super bonus key mould is reached during free drops.
modes.effects: 7 free drops with sticky Multiplier Wilds. Avalanche, Burst, coins, and Multiplier Wild rules still apply. Burst activates before awarding additional free drops if another bonus trigger happens in the same free drop. Wins paid at end of bonus mode.
modes.end_condition: Ends when no free drops remain or when the win cap (10,000x bet) has been reached.

phases.state_changes: free_drops=7; MW sticky enabled

phases.state_changes: Sticky MWs persist; free_drops decremented; possible +3 and upgrade

phases.state_changes: Return to base game

modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Both coins and Multiplier Wilds are sticky between free drops.
modes.effects: 7 free drops with sticky coins and sticky Multiplier Wilds. Same Avalanche/Burst ordering rules. Wins paid at end of bonus mode.
modes.end_condition: Ends when no free drops remain or when the win cap (10,000x bet) has been reached.

features.name: Avalanche
features.trigger: After any drop with cluster wins
features.effects: Collect cluster wins → winning symbols explode → remaining fall with gravity (L/R slide; non-wilds through wilds) → new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.

features.name: Multiplier Wild creation and growth
features.trigger: Winning cluster of solely payout symbols (not coins)
features.effects: Creates x1 Multiplier Wild in a vacant position. MW +1 per winning cluster it participates in; MWs in same cluster add then multiply win; after win, multipliers increase then merge into new MW.

features.name: Coins merge
features.trigger: Cluster of coin symbols
features.effects: Pays aggregate coin value (x bet each); leaves a new coin with that aggregate. Solely-coin cluster does not create Multiplier Wild. MWs in coin cluster add then multiply the coin win.

features.name: Burst
features.trigger: End of round / free drop when nothing else can happen
features.when: After avalanches settle; before bonus start or before awarding extra free drops if trigger same drop
features.effects: Blocker transforms self+adjacent into same payout symbol or coins (not wild). Unaffected: coins, bonus, burst, Multiplier Wild. Adjacent bursts chain. Multiple bursts activate simultaneously but act individually.

features.name: X-iter
features.trigger: Player selects an X-iter mode in base game only
features.effects: Five paid modes (Bonus Hunt 2x, Wild Concoction 10x, Coin Burst 25x, Bonus 100x, Super Bonus 500x). All X-iter RTP 94.0%. See feature_buy.options for each mode.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Key features: Name Ryze; ELK Game id 10224; Theoretical RTP 94.0%; Cluster wins (at least 5 connecting symbols); Reels 5 to 6 columns; Rows 6 rows; Hit frequency 27.4%; Min bet €0.20; Max bet €100.00; Max exposure 10 000x max bet; Max win single spin 10 000x max bet; Maximum win €1,000,000.00.

Ryze is a 6 rows and 5-to-6 columns slot with an offset symbol grid, dropping symbols and cluster wins. A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected. Only the largest cluster of the connected identical symbols is paid out. Symbols drop vertically with gravity and slide to the left and right repeatedly as far downwards as possible. All symbols except wild symbols can fall through wild symbols. All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols that were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

A winning cluster of solely payout symbols, not coins, creates a x1 Multiplier Wild in one of the vacant positions created after a win. The Multiplier Wild increases its multiplier by 1 for each winning cluster it is a part of... The multiplier values of all Multiplier Wilds that are part of the same cluster are added and the sum is then multiplied by the winning cluster. After the win, the individual multipliers are increased before being multiplied and merged into a new Multiplier Wild. The Multiplier Wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the bonus and burst symbols. A cluster of solely coin symbols does not create a Multiplier Wild.

The burst symbol is a blocker that is activated at the end of the game round when there is nothing more that can happen. It changes itself and adjacent symbols into the same payout symbol or into coins, it does not transform into wild. ... A bonus symbol that reaches the bonus key mould below the game grid triggers the bonus game with 7 free drops. Multiplier Wilds are sticky between free drops in the bonus game. A bonus symbol that reaches a position with a super bonus key mould ... triggers the super bonus game with 7 free drops. Both coins and Multiplier Wilds are sticky ... 3 additional free drops are awarded when a bonus symbol reaches the bonus key mould during a bonus game. The bonus game and super bonus game end when no free drops remain or when the win cap has been reached. Winnings are paid out at the end of the bonus mode.

X-iter: Super Bonus 500x guaranteed Super Bonus; Bonus 100x guaranteed Bonus; Coin Burst 25x Burst in first drop and bursts always give coins; Wild Concoction 10x starts with a number of Multiplier Wilds; Bonus Hunt 2x more than TRIPLE chance of Bonus/Super Bonus. X-iter only in base game. Min X-iter cost €0.40, max €50,000.00. RTP for all X-iter modes 94.0%.

modes.retrigger: Retrigger mentioned (see effects)
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 7-15 free spins by landing FS scatter symbols at the same time during the Cursed FS Respin in base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, when the 3rd Pot symbol of the same color lands, the corresponding Chest is guaranteed to activate. Chests can activate before the 3rd Pot symbol lands; in this case, the count resets, and 3 new Pot symbols of that color are required to guarantee an activation.

 When activated, the Cursed Coins Bonus sequence counts as one free spin.

 The number of FS symbols that land during the Cursed FS Respin determines the number of extra free spins awarded in this bonus. If an FS Upgrade symbol lands, it awards an upgrade into the GHOSTLY GALLOWS bonus. When upgrading to a new bonus, the existing free spins and the awarded free spins will be transferred to the new bonus.

 In this bonus, the additional free spins awarded during the Cursed FS Respin are between 2-10.

 When activated, the Cursed Coins Bonus sequence counts as one free spin.

 Coins can only land in Cursed Coins Bonus sequence.

Wild Multipliers can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x.

 Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond Coins can also land and stick to the grid until the end of the Magic Coins Bonus sequence. All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet

respins.how_it_works:
The Zephyr Crest symbol activates when at least one Wild Spirit and one Zephyr Crest symbol appear on the grid at the same time. Once activated, the Zephyr Crest symbol expands all Spirit symbols on the grid, even if they are not part of a win. The Zephyr Crest symbol nudges all Wild Spirit symbols one reel to the left, awards a Respin, and applies a new Multiplier value to each Wild Spirit on the grid.

 Wild Spirits cannot be nudged off the grid. They will be nudged to the leftmost reel that is not already occupied by a Wild Spirit. Wild Spirits on the leftmost reel will remain in place and receive a new Multiplier during the Respin. New Spirits and Zephyr Crest symbols can land during the Respins, triggering more Wild Spirits and nudges. Only one Zephyr Crest symbol can land on the grid at a time.

wilds.name: EXPANDED WILD SPIRITS
wilds.behavior:
When a Spirit symbol lands, it expands into a Wild Spirit if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Spirit symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Spirit symbols that land on the top row will still be counted as expanded Wild Spirits if part of a win. Expanded Wild Spirits count as Wilds on every position the expanded symbol covers. Only one Spirit symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 When a Wild Spirit expands it reveals a Multiplier which is applied to the entire Wild Spirit. If a winning combination includes more than one Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win. respins.how_it_works:
Landing the golden S’n’S scatter symbol activates the Stack’n’Sync™ feature and guarantees that all 5 reels are stacked. Only high-paying symbols and the Wild symbol can be stacked by the golden S’n’S.

 The golden S’n’S also activates a global multiplier that is applied to any wins on the respin. The multiplier is shown in the upper left corner above the reels.

 The multiplier can have one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

wilds.name: STACK’N’SYNC™
wilds.behavior:
Landing the S’n’S scatter symbol activates the Stack’n’Sync™ feature.

 The reel where the symbol landed is copied to up to 4 other reels and these reels are then stacked with one kind of symbol. The stacked symbols replace existing symbols on the reels. The game then awards a respin, with the stacked reels synced to each other so they stop in the same position.

 Landing another S’n’S symbol during the respin will repeat the stacking on additional reels and sync them, and award an additional respin.

 The stacked symbol and the stack amount is shown by the symbol and stars that appear in the upper right corner above the reels. Each filled star represents one quarter of the reels. Reels can be a quarter, half, three-quarters or fully stacked!

 All regular paying symbols, the Wild symbol, and the FS symbol can be stacked. The Eagle Claw bonus symbol can not be stacked.

wilds.name: EAGLE LINK
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the Eagle Link bonus by landing 3 Eagle Claw scatter symbols simultaneously in the base game.

 This bonus has two phases: a collect phase and a payout phase. Only Eagle symbols, Golden Eagle symbols and non-paying symbols appear in this bonus.

 During the collect phase all landed Eagle and Golden Eagle symbols are sticky. The collect phase has 3 spins that refill when a new Eagle or Golden Eagle sticks. After 3 spins in a row without sticking new symbols, the collect phase ends and the bonus transitions to the payout phase. No wins are awarded during the collect phase.

 Every landed Golden Eagle symbol activates the Eagle Link feature. The Eagle Link connects to all Eagle symbols that land vertically or horizontally adjacent to a Golden Eagle or another Eagle symbol already connected to the Eagle Link. When the collect phase ends, all Eagle symbols that are not connected to the Eagle Link are removed.

 The following symbols are non-paying:

 The payout phase initially awards 3 spins. Golden Eagle symbols are sticky and each that lands during this phase awards 1 additional spin.

 The payout phase has a global multiplier that applies to all Eagle symbol wins. The multiplier value is equal to the number of stuck Golden Eagle symbols.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

 The Golden Eagle symbol appears only in the Eagle Link bonus game and substitutes for Eagle symbols when calculating wins.

 The Eagle Claw symbol appears only in the base game.

 The FS symbol appears only in the base game.

wilds.name: WRATH REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Wrath scatter symbol lands, it expands into a Wild Wrath Reel. Once expanded, the Wrath Reel will reveal a Multiplier that is applied to the entire Wrath Reel. If a winning combination includes more than one Wrath Reel, the Wrath Reel Multiplier values will be added together from left to right and then applied to the win. modes.name: BONUS GAME - WRATH AND RUIN
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 3 refilling lives by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus game, lives are displayed on a Life Meter outside the grid, where 3 lives equal 3 free spins. When any Disc Multiplier or Battle Horse symbol lands, the lives and free spins are refilled to 3, once all lives are consumed, the bonus ends.

 During this bonus, a Reel Multiplier above each reel starts at 1x. Only dead symbols, Disc Multipliers, and Battle Horses can land. By landing different Disc Multipliers, the Reel Multipliers above the reels progressively increase throughout the bonus.

 Green Disc symbols add their revealed value to the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Green Disc symbols add their revealed value to all Reel Multipliers once.

 Possible Adding Multiplier values for all Green Disc symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Red Disc symbols multiply their revealed value by the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Red Disc symbols multiply all Reel Multipliers by their revealed value once.

 Possible Multiplying Multiplier values for all Red Disc symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 When a Battle Horse symbol lands, it is collected above the reel it landed on. At the end of the free spins, the collected Battle Horse activates and reveals a Multiplier. The Battle Horse Multiplier is only applied to the Reel Multiplier above the corresponding reel. Only 1 Battle Horse can land on each reel. The Battle Horse symbol can have the following Multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25, x50.

 Once the Battle Horse activation is complete, all Reel Multiplier values are added together and multiplied by the bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a Cash symbol lands, it will activate and expand from that symbol upwards to the top of the reel after all wins and cascades have been handled on that spin.

 When a Cash symbol expands, it turns into a Cash Stack. Cash symbols that land on the top row are counted as Cash Stacks. Each position on the grid that the Cash Stack covers will reveal 1 of the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 500x, 1 000x, 5 000x, 10 000x. Once expanded, the Cash Stack Multiplier values will be added and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. If there is more than 1 Cash Stack on the grid, the Multipliers will first be added, then multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. Only 1 Cash Stack can land on a reel at a time.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - REACTOR RIOT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the BROS BEFORE BLOWS bonus. In addition, this bonus guarantees 1 bash from Oskar and 1 smash from Fred on each free spin! If there are already Cash Stacks on every reel, only Fred will activate and smash the Cash Stacks. The order of the bash and smash activation may vary.

 FS symbols cannot land in the REACTOR RIOT bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land above a Cash symbol on the same reel.

multipliers.name: CASH STACKS
multipliers.behavior:
When a Cash symbol lands, it will activate and expand from that symbol upwards to the top of the reel after all wins and cascades have been handled on that spin.

 When a Cash symbol expands, it turns into a Cash Stack. Cash symbols that land on the top row are counted as Cash Stacks. Each position on the grid that the Cash Stack covers will reveal 1 of the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 500x, 1 000x, 5 000x, 10 000x. Once expanded, the Cash Stack Multiplier values will be added and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. If there is more than 1 Cash Stack on the grid, the Multipliers will first be added, then multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. Only 1 Cash Stack can land on a reel at a time.

multipliers.name: THE BASHING BROS
multipliers.behavior:
When the current grid has settled, and there is a Cash Stack on the grid, there is a chance that Oskar, on the left side, will activate and bash the grid, or Fred, on the right side, will activate and smash the grid. When Oskar bashes the grid, between 1- 4 regular symbols will be removed from 1 random reel that does not already contain a Cash Stack. A Cash symbol will then be added to the first empty position at the lowest part of the empty reel and expand into a Cash Stack, revealing new Multiplier values

 When Fred smashes the grid, all the Cash Stacks on the grid will be compressed down towards their original Cash symbol. When the Cash Stack is compressed, 1 more Multiplier is added to every position the Cash Stack covers. The Multiplier on each new position will be the same as the previous Multipliers that already existed on those positions. If the Cash Stack values were 2x, 5x, 3x, it will become 2x, 5x, 3x, 2x, 5x, 3x.

 When Oskar activates first and bashes the grid, followed by Fred smashing it, the new Cash Stacks created by Oskar will also be compressed and receive double the Multiplier values. Oskar and Fred can each activate once per spin. If there are already Cash Stacks on every reel, only Fred will activate and bash the Cash Stacks. features.name: CASH STACKS
features.effects:
When a Cash symbol lands, it will activate and expand from that symbol upwards to the top of the reel after all wins and cascades have been handled on that spin.

 When a Cash symbol expands, it turns into a Cash Stack. Cash symbols that land on the top row are counted as Cash Stacks. Each position on the grid that the Cash Stack covers will reveal 1 of the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 500x, 1 000x, 5 000x, 10 000x. Once expanded, the Cash Stack Multiplier values will be added and multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. If there is more than 1 Cash Stack on the grid, the Multipliers will first be added, then multiplied by the current bet amount to determine the awarded win. Only 1 Cash Stack can land on a reel at a time.

features.name: THE BASHING BROS
features.effects:
When the current grid has settled, and there is a Cash Stack on the grid, there is a chance that Oskar, on the left side, will activate and bash the grid, or Fred, on the right side, will activate and smash the grid. When Oskar bashes the grid, between 1- 4 regular symbols will be removed from 1 random reel that does not already contain a Cash Stack. A Cash symbol will then be added to the first empty position at the lowest part of the empty reel and expand into a Cash Stack, revealing new Multiplier values

 When Fred smashes the grid, all the Cash Stacks on the grid will be compressed down towards their original Cash symbol. When the Cash Stack is compressed, 1 more Multiplier is added to every position the Cash Stack covers. The Multiplier on each new position will be the same as the previous Multipliers that already existed on those positions. If the Cash Stack values were 2x, 5x, 3x, it will become 2x, 5x, 3x, 2x, 5x, 3x.

 When Oskar activates first and bashes the grid, followed by Fred smashing it, the new Cash Stacks created by Oskar will also be compressed and receive double the Multiplier values. Oskar and Fred can each activate once per spin. If there are already Cash Stacks on every reel, only Fred will activate and bash the Cash Stacks. Cash Stacks are removed from the grid before the next spin.

scatters.name: BOOK OF STACKWAYS™
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 10 free spins.

 At the beginning of the bonus game, 2 paying symbols are randomly chosen to be the Special symbols. When one of the Special symbols lands on at least 3 reels at the same time, indicators below the corresponding reels will light up to reveal a number from 2 - 10. Those reels will then be stacked with the shown amount of the winning symbol.

 Stacked symbols pay as if the stacked reels were connected from left to right.

 If more than one Special symbol type lands on 3 or more reels at the same time, they will stack and pay one type at a time.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins.

 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins. 

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time upgrades the feature to SUPER BOOK OF STACKWAYS™ and awards 4 extra spins.

When one of the Special symbols lands on at least 3 reels at the same time, indicators below the corresponding reels will light up to reveal a number from 2 - 10. The revealed value corresponds to the number of stacks that will be added to the reel above the number.

 When the symbol has been stacked in this way, they will pay as if all reels were counted sequentially from left to right.

 If more than one Special symbol lands on 3 or more reels, they will stack and pay one at a time.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 extra spins.

 3 FS symbols awards 4 extra spins.

specials.name: STACKWAYS™
specials.behavior:
Land Stackways™ symbols on a reel to fill that reel with a stack of paying symbols. Between 2 to 10 symbols can be stacked on each reel.

 There are two types of Stackways™ symbols:

 Normal Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 2, 3, 4

 Revealing Stackways™ symbols with the possible values: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

 The stacked symbol is determined by choosing the symbol that would grant the longest winning combination among the symbols present on the reels when the Stackways™ symbol activates. If more than one winning combination of equal length could be created, the symbol will be chosen randomly from among the symbols that could create those winning combinations. The stacking only occurs when the result would create a winning combination.

modes.name: BONUS GAME -TOP-SHELF TROUBLE
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 2 FS Pairs during the base game.

 This bonus game has a Bash Bar added as an extra row at the top of the grid. After each spin, once all regular wins are collected, the Bash Bar reveals a symbol for each reel from left to right. The revealed symbol can be either a dead symbol or a paying symbol. Dead symbols are non-paying and have no other effect.

 When a paying symbol is revealed and a matching half of the same symbol is present in the connected reel, the revealed symbol will convert its matching position into the same symbol, creating a winning Pair. For example, if a red low-paying symbol is revealed on reel 1’s Bash Bar and reel 2 contains one or more red low-paying symbols, the matching positions on reel 1 will be converted to red low-paying symbols to create winning Pairs. Bash Bar wins cannot occur on previous winning positions on the same spin.

 Symbols converted by the Bash Bar revert to their original state once they form a win, allowing the possibility of two separate wins on the same positions. Special Symbols; Wild, FS, and Multipliers cannot land in the Bash Bar during this bonus. Active Global Multipliers will appear outside the grid.

 Landing additional FS Pairs in the bonus awards 2 extra free spins per pair.

respins.how_it_works:
Land Stack’n’Sync™ scatter symbols to stack any paying symbol on the reels. A stack of 60 symbols fills the whole reel! Fill an entire reel with the same symbol and sync all reels for massive wins!

 The first time in a round that one or more Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land, the reels where they land will be filled with a stack of 15, 30, 45 or 60 symbols of one kind.
Only 1 Stack’n’Sync™ symbol can land on each reel in a round.

For each Stack’n’Sync™ symbol that lands 1 respin is awarded. If additional Stack’n’Sync™ symbols land during the respins, those reels are synced to the already stacked reels which copies the symbols from the stacked reel and makes the reels stop in the same position.

 These symbols are non-paying:

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all High or Low paying symbols.

 The bonus symbol only appears in the base game.

The Stack symbol only appears in Stampede Spins.

wilds.name: It's a Classic!
wilds.behavior:
This feature is triggered by landing 3, 4 or 5 Book scatter symbols in the base game. When the feature is activated, 1 or more symbols are selected as the special symbol for the duration of the feature.

 Landing 3 Book symbols awards 10 free spins and 1 special symbol.
Landing 4 Book symbols awards 15 free spins and 2 special symbols.
Landing 5 Book symbols awards 20 free spins and 3 special symbols.

 Only Low or High paying symbols can be selected as special symbols. The Book symbol cannot be selected. Selected symbols are displayed with a golden frame and color change. See paytable for illustration.

 If the special symbols land anywhere on at least 3 reels they will spread to cover the reels that they landed on after all normal wins are awarded. After spreading, special symbols pay anywhere and can form paylines even if there are other symbols between them. If more than one special symbol lands on 3 reels during the same spin, they spread and create wins one at a time. The Book symbol does not count as a Wild symbol during this stage and cannot be a part of special symbol paylines that pay anywhere.

 Landing 3 Book symbols during the feature awards 5 extra spins and selects 1 additional special symbol. This can occur only until the special symbol bar above the grid is filled, after which no further retriggers are awarded.

The value of the wild multipliers on each reel will be determined by the time shown on the clock at the top of that reel!

 If more than one Multiplier Clock is part of a winning line, their multiplier values are first added together and then applied to the win.

wilds.name: BOOSTBAR™
wilds.behavior:
Introducing our latest feature BOOSTBAR™. An exciting feature bar that consists of four extra positions located above the reels. Every time that a BOOSTBAR™ activator symbol lands on the grid, the BOOSTBAR™ is activated and 4 special feature symbols will land on the bar. The symbols can be either blocking stones, a symbol that clears the grid, paying symbols, symbol multipliers, global multipliers or wilds. If one or more stones land, those positions are locked.

 BOOSTBAR™ FEATURE OVERVIEW:

 BLOCKING STONES

 This symbol blocks the position it lands on until the next round.

 MAGIC LANTERN

 This symbol will jump out of the bar and land on the grid. Once it lands it will clear the grid and a new symbol drop will take place.

 SYMBOLS WITH SPLITTER FUNCTIONALITY

 Can be any of the paying symbols, they will also have an amount in the top right corner. The amount tells you how many symbols will jump out of the bar and land on a random position on the grid.
The amounts can be 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 symbols.

 WILDS

 Wild symbols will jump out of the bar and land on a random position on the grid. They can have an amount in the top right corner - the amount tells you how many symbols will jump out.
The amounts can be 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30.

 SYMBOL MULTIPLIERS

 Can be any of the paying symbols. Each symbol has a multiplier displayed in the top right corner. The multiplier amount will be multiplied by all wins on that symbol during the round. If there are two or more with the same symbol the multiplier values will first be added and then multiplied by the wins.
The symbol multiplier amounts can be 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x or 30x. 

 GLOBAL MULTIPLIERS

 These multipliers are global, which means that all wins during the round will be multiplied by the value. If land several global multipliers and/or symbol multipliers, all applicable multiplier values will first be added and then multiplied by the wins.
The global multiplier amounts can be 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x,

wilds.behavior:
The Cranky Cat symbol is a wild multiplier that multiplies all the winning combinations that it’s part of in the base game. More than one Cranky Cat can land at the same time and be part of the same winning combination, or different ones. When more than one Cranky Cat is part of the same win, their values multiply each other and the product is then applied to the win.

 Each Cranky Cat can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 In the base game, at most one Cranky Cat can land at a time on each reel and the Cranky Cat symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 BONUS! scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the Bonus feature!

 In the Bonus, the game transforms and only non-paying symbols and multiplier scatter symbols will appear!

 Above each reel is a reel multiplier that starts at 1x. By landing multiplier symbols of different types, the reel multipliers above the reels are progressively increased! When the Bonus ends, all reel multipliers will be added together and then multiplied with your bet to determine the final win amount!

 The special multiplier symbols that appear in the Bonus feature are as follows.

 Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Sketchy Skull symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Cranky Cat symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 The Bonus has 3 refilling lives that reset each time one of the above multiplier symbols lands. Each life represents one spin. Once all 3 lives are consumed without a new reset, the Bonus ends.

features.name: A VERY CRANKY CAT
features.effects:
The Cranky Cat symbol is a wild multiplier that multiplies all the winning combinations that it’s part of in the base game. More than one Cranky Cat can land at the same time and be part of the same winning combination, or different ones. When more than one Cranky Cat is part of the same win, their values multiply each other and the product is then applied to the win.

 Each Cranky Cat can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 In the base game, at most one Cranky Cat can land at a time on each reel and the Cranky Cat symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

features.name: BONUS
features.effects:
Land 3 BONUS! scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the Bonus feature!

 In the Bonus, the game transforms and only non-paying symbols and multiplier scatter symbols will appear!

 Above each reel is a reel multiplier that starts at 1x. By landing multiplier symbols of different types, the reel multipliers above the reels are progressively increased! When the Bonus ends, all reel multipliers will be added together and then multiplied with your bet to determine the final win amount!

 The special multiplier symbols that appear in the Bonus feature are as follows.

 Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Sketchy Skull: adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Sketchy Skull: stays on the grid and adds its displayed value to ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Sketchy Skull symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed one time.
Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with the reel multiplier where it landed on every subsequent spin.
Epic Cranky Cat: multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers one time.
Epic Sticky Cranky Cat: stays on the grid and multiplies its displayed value with ALL reel multipliers on every subsequent spin.

 Possible multiplier values for all Cranky Cat symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 The Bonus has 3 refilling lives that reset each time one of the above multiplier symbols lands. Each life represents one spin. Once all 3 lives are consumed without a new reset, the Bonus ends.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - AN EPIC GLITCH!
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with free spins and 3 refilling lives by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 The Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the mechanics of THE KORRUPTED K9 bonus. In addition, this bonus guarantees a full grid with Crazy Multipliers, 1 Chaos Upgrade symbol, and at least 1 Glitch Dog symbol from the start!

multipliers.name: CAN YOU SPELL CHAOS?
multipliers.behavior:
Landing 5 low-paying symbols that spell out CHAOS horizontally across a row will trigger an EPIC DROP™.

 When the EPIC DROP™ is activated in normal gameplay, it triggers 1 reward spin. During the EPIC DROP™ reward spin, a Reel Multiplier above each reel starts at 1x. All symbols are replaced with dead symbols, and all 5 low-paying CHAOS symbols are transformed into Glitch Dog symbols, which jump to new positions before the grid settles.

 Once the Glitch Dog symbol lands in its new position, each Glitch Dog symbol will glitch into a Crazy Multiplier symbol.

 The 4 Crazy Multiplier symbols are:

 Sketchy Skull symbols add their revealed value to the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Sketchy Skull symbols add their revealed value to all Reel Multipliers once.

 Possible Adding Multiplier values for all Sketchy Skull symbols are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Cranky Cat symbols multiply their revealed value with the Reel Multiplier for the reel they land on once.

 Epic Cranky Cat symbols multiply all Reel Multipliers by their revealed value once.

 Possible Multiplying Multiplier values for all Cranky Cat symbols are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 The Reel Multipliers above the reels increase progressively depending on which Crazy Multiplier is revealed by the Glitch Dog symbol or from other Crazy Multiplier symbols that can land. Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dog symbols reveal in order from top to bottom, left to right. When the reward spin ends, all Reel Multipliers are added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win. The grid then resets, and the Reel Multiplier is removed for the next spin.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - CTRL + ALT + CHAOS
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with free spins and 3 refilling lives by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus game, lives are displayed on a Life Meter outside the grid, where 3 lives equal 3 free spins. When any Crazy Multiplier symbol lands, the lives and free spins are refilled to 3. A Glitch Dog symbol will refill the Life Meter to max, only the first time it lands on the grid. Once all lives are consumed, the bonus ends.

 Additionally, the Reel Multiplier, which starts at 1x, remains active outside the grid throughout the bonus. Only dead symbols, Glitch Dog symbols, and Crazy Multipliers can land. By landing different Crazy Multipliers or Glitch Dog symbols, the Reel Multipliers above the reels progressively increase during the bonus.

 When a Glitch Dog symbol lands, it glitches into one of the Crazy Multiplier symbols at the time of the symbols' reveal. That Crazy Multiplier value will be added to the Reel Multiplier. After all the reveals and all the Multipliers have been added to the Reel Multiplier, the Glitch Dog symbol returns to its original form and jumps to a new position on the next spin. When it lands, it glitches into a new Crazy Multiplier when it’s time for its reveal. This continues until the end of the bonus.

 At the end of the bonus, all Reel Multipliers are added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THE KORRUPTED K9
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with free spins and 3 refilling lives by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game retains the mechanics of the CTRL + ALT + CHAOS bonus and guarantees that at least 4 Crazy Multipliers and 1 Glitch Dog symbol land at the start. In addition, a Chaos Upgrade symbol can land and activate if a Crazy Multiplier or Glitch Dog symbol is within 1 position of where the Chaos Upgrade symbol lands, within a 3x3 square.

 When activated, the Chaos Upgrade symbol will add a Multiplier value to all Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dog symbols within the 3x3 square. Chaos Upgrade symbols can have Adding Multiplier values ranging from 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Crazy Multipliers and Glitch Dog symbols within the 3x3 square will first reveal their values. Then, the Chaos Upgrade symbol adds its Multiplier value to each Crazy Multiplier and Glitch Dog symbol in the square. Finally, the updated Multiplier values are added to the Reel Multiplier. The Multiplier value of the Chaos Upgrade symbol itself is not added to the Reel Multiplier.

 The Chaos Upgrade symbol is removed from the grid for the next free spin. Landing Chaos Upgrade symbols does not refill the Life Meter. Only 1 Chaos Upgrade symbol can land on the grid at a time.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: land three Free Spin symbols, the game changes into free spin mode.
modes.effects:
If you land three Free Spin symbols, the game changes into free spin mode. The free spins mode starts with 3 spins. The free spins continue until you get three non-winning spins in a row. Every time you get a winning symbol, the number of free spins is reset to 3. The meter to the right of the grid displays the number of remaining spins.

A number is displayed above each reel. At the end of the free spins mode, the total win will equal the sum of all displayed numbers multiplied with the current bet level. All symbols affecting the multipliers are applied in the order left to right, top to bottom.

The symbols appearing in the free spins mode are described below:

 Every time the Cranky Cat symbol appears, it will multiply the number shown above the current reel with the factor revealed inside the Cranky Cat symbol. The possible multipliers are x2, x3, x5, x10, x20.

 Cranky Cat also has an Epic version. This symbol works the same way as the regular Cranky Cat symbol, but multiplies the value displayed above all reels with the factor shown! The possible multipliers are x2, x3, x5, x10, x20.

 The Sketchy Skull symbol will add the number revealed inside the Sketchy Skull symbol to the current reel’s multiplier. The possible multipliers are +1, +2, +5, +10, +20.

 The Epic Sketchy Skull symbol will add the number revealed inside the Sketchy Skull symbol to the factors shown above all reels! The possible multipliers are +1, +2, +5, +10, +20.

 These symbols are non-winning.

respins.how_it_works:
When a Tree of Life has fully expanded from the bottom row to the top row of a reel, the Circle of Life is triggered on that Tree of Life. The Circle of Life will activate during the Respin before the grid has settled.

 The Circle of Life spins and lands on a Multiplier or a Skull. The Multiplier on which the arrow lands will be combined with the Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on an Additive Multiplier, the two values will be added together for a new total Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on a Multiplicative Multiplier, the Tree of Life value will be multiplied by the Circle of Life value for a new total. The Circle of Life Multipliers can have the following values:

 Additive Multiplying values: 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 100x

 Multiplicative Multiplying value: x2

 The Circle of Life will continue spinning and landing on Multiplier values until the arrow lands on the Skull, which ends the Circle of Life. The grid will settle, and new wins formed with the Tree of Life are awarded with the new total Multiplier value on the Tree of Life. A new Respin is triggered, and the Tree of Life is removed from the grid.

wilds.name: TREE OF LIFE
wilds.behavior:
When a Tree symbol lands, it acts as a Wild symbol that substitutes for all symbols in the paytable and reveals a Multiplier value. If the Tree symbol is part of a win, it triggers a Respin, and the Tree symbol expands into a Tree of Life.

 When a Tree symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is multiplied by the value shown on the Tree symbol. If more than one Tree symbol is part of the same winning combination, their values are first added together before being applied to the win. Tree symbols have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Once the wins are awarded, a Respin is triggered, the winning Tree symbols will stick to the grid and expand upward by one row into a Tree of Life while everything else respins. The Respin sequence continues when new wins occur on the Tree of Life or other Tree symbols on the grid. The Tree of Life will continue to expand by one row on every Respin sequence until the Tree of Life fully expands by reaching the top of the grid. scatters.name: SPREADING FS SYMBOLS
scatters.behavior:
When 3 or more FS scatter symbols land simultaneously, each FS symbol expands across the entire reel it lands on after all wins have been awarded. Every position the FS symbol covers represents a certain number of free spins. The total number of free spins awarded for the bonus is determined by adding up all the numbers on positions covered by each FS symbol. FS symbols can have the following values: +1, +2, +3.

 When triggering and buying a bonus, there is a chance that some positions on expanding FS symbols will transform into Upgrade symbols, upgrading you to the next bonus.

 Landing 3 expanding FS symbols with 1 Upgrade symbol awards an upgrade to the ETERNAL bonus.

 Landing 3 expanding FS symbols with 2 Upgrade symbols awards an upgrade to the REBIRTH bonus.

 Landing 4 expanding FS symbols with 1 Upgrade symbol awards an upgrade to the REBIRTH bonus.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - REBIRTH

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the ETERNAL bonus. In addition, reels 2 and 4 are activated from the start!

multipliers.name: CIRCLE OF LIFE
multipliers.behavior:
When a Tree of Life has fully expanded from the bottom row to the top row of a reel, the Circle of Life is triggered on that Tree of Life. The Circle of Life will activate during the Respin before the grid has settled.

 The Circle of Life spins and lands on a Multiplier or a Skull. The Multiplier on which the arrow lands will be combined with the Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on an Additive Multiplier, the two values will be added together for a new total Multiplier on the Tree of Life. If the arrow lands on a Multiplicative Multiplier, the Tree of Life value will be multiplied by the Circle of Life value for a new total. The Circle of Life Multipliers can have the following values:

 Additive Multiplying values: 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 100x

 Multiplicative Multiplying value: x2

 The Circle of Life will continue spinning and landing on Multiplier values until the arrow lands on the Skull, which ends the Circle of Life. The grid will settle, and new wins formed with the Tree of Life are awarded with the new total Multiplier value on the Tree of Life. A new Respin is triggered, and the Tree of Life is removed from the grid.

 In this bonus game, a progressive Divine Multiplier collects all multiplier values that are a part of a win before adding it to the total win; these multipliers are then stored in the progressive Divine Multiplier portal and increase with each following winning spin containing multiplier symbols.

 All following multiplier values will first be added to the Divine Multiplier portal and then the new total will be added to the Total Win bar.

 If there is a win, but no multipliers on the grid, the Divine Multiplier stays inactive.

respins.how_it_works:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the PLAY WITH SAFIRE bonus. In addition, a 3x3 Colossal Diamond symbol is guaranteed to land during the first free spin.

 Diamond symbols can have the following Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land during Dandy Respins.

wilds.name: COLOSSAL DIAMOND SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
If 4 or more Diamond symbols land in a square formation of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 they merge to form a Colossal Diamond symbol. When the Colossal Diamond is formed, any Diamond Multiplier values are added together and applied to the Colossal Diamond symbol. Colossal Diamond symbols act as a Wild symbol, substituting for all symbols in the paytable. The Multiplier value of the Colossal Diamond symbol is applied to each winning combination that the Colossal Diamond symbol is part of.

 A Colossal Diamond symbol can grow if additional Diamond symbols land around the existing Colossal Diamond in such a way that they collectively form a larger square formation, for example growing from 2x2 to 3x3.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - ICE AND SHINE
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the PLAY WITH SAFIRE bonus. In addition, a 3x3 Colossal Diamond symbol is guaranteed to land during the first free spin.

 Diamond symbols can have the following Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land during Dandy Respins.

multipliers.name: BOLT SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
A Bolt symbol is activated when it lands within a 3x3 square formation surrounding a Diamond symbol or Colossal Diamond symbol. When activated, the Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamonds inside the surrounding 3x3 square formation before any wins are rewarded. When the wins have been awarded, the Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. Bolt symbols add one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 An Epic Bolt symbol will activate when it lands while there is any Diamond on the grid. An activated Epic Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamond symbols on the grid before any wins have been handled. When the wins have been handled, the Epic Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Epic Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. The Epic Bolt symbol adds one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 Only 1 Bolt and Epic Bolt can land during the same spin. When a Bolt and Epic Bolt symbol land and activate during the same spin, the Bolt symbol will activate before the Epic Bolt symbol.

modes.name: DIAMOND SYMBOLS AND DANDY RESPINS
modes.trigger: When the Diamond symbol has landed, it will trigger a Dandy Respin after all winning combinations have been handled.
modes.effects:
When a Diamond symbol lands, it acts as a Wild, substituting for all symbols in the paytable. Diamond symbols can also land with an Additive Multiplier. Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 When the Diamond symbol has landed, it will trigger a Dandy Respin after all winning combinations have been handled. During a Dandy Respin, all Diamond symbols are Sticky, meaning that they keep their grid position and Multiplier value, while new symbols spin in. Every time a new Diamond symbol lands, another Dandy Respin is awarded. The Respin sequence continues until no new Diamond symbols land or there are no more available positions on the grid.

 Wins are awarded after every Dandy Respin. When a Diamond Multiplier participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the Diamond’s Multiplier value. If more than one Diamond symbol is part of the same winning combination, their Multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.
