wilds.name: BANANA SPLIT? NO, BANANA SPREAD!
wilds.behavior:
Spreading Banana symbols can point either to the left, or up.

 When a Spreading Banana lands, additional Spreading Banana symbols will spread from that symbol either left or up depending on the direction the original Spreading Banana symbol points. When it points up, Spreading Banana symbols will spread upward on the same reel to the edge of the grid, and when it points left Spreading Banana symbols will spread to the left on the same row to the edge of the grid.

 The spreading will only occur if the Spreading Bananas would be part of at least one winning combination after spreading.

 All Spreading Banana symbols are wild multipliers that substitute for the other symbols in the paytable. Each Spreading Banana symbol will reveal its multiplier value after landing, before spreading. All Spreading Bananas created by spreading will take on the same multiplier value as the Spreading Banana symbol they originate from. If two Spreading Banana symbols spread over the same grid position, their multiplier values will be added together on that position.

 Spreading Banana symbols can have one of the following multiplier values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 When at least one Spreading Banana symbol is part of a winning payline, the multiplier is applied to the win. If a winning payline includes more than one Spreading Banana symbol, the multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: BANANA BLITZ!
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the BANANA BLITZ! bonus game with 10 free spins. 

 This bonus game features Sticky Banana symbols and the Go Bananas symbol.

 Landed Sticky Banana symbols stay on the grid until the end of the bonus. Each Sticky Banana symbol is given a new random multiplier on each spin from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 If there is a minimum of one Sticky Banana symbol on the grid and you land a Go Bananas symbol, the Go Bananas mechanic will activate immediately.

 When activated, the Go Bananas symbol will reveal a value between 3 - 10. This number represents the number of Banana copies that will be created from each of the Sticky Banana symbols currently on the grid.

 Example: If there are 3 Sticky Banana symbols on the grid when landing a Go Bananas symbol that reveals a value of 3, 9 copied Bananas will be added to the grid. Some Bananas can land on top of each other, reducing the actual number of Bananas that appear on the grid.

 Copied Bananas are wild multipliers symbols that will appear in random positions on the grid and substitute for other symbols in the paytable. A copied Banana symbol will always have the same multiplier value as the Sticky Banana symbol it was copied from. If two copied Banana symbols land on the same position, their multiplier values will be added together.

 Copied Bananas are removed from the grid on the next spin. Go Bananas symbols are also removed on the next spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

expanding_reels.how_it_works:
The DuelReels™ mechanic transforms the entire reel to a wild multiplier! Landing the VS symbol triggers an expanding reel with a duel between two fruits with multipliers. The reel only expands if it would create, or be part of, at least one winning combination when expanded.

 The fruit that wins the duel will apply its multiplier to the whole reel. The whole reel becomes wild and the value of any connecting winlines is multiplied by the reel multiplier. If more than one wild reel is part of a winning combination, their multipliers will first be added together and then applied to the win.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

wilds.name: HUNTING SEASON
wilds.behavior:
When a Hunting Season symbol lands on the grid, a Hunt is triggered after all regular wins are handled. One target is located above each reel. Five shots are fired from left to right that will either hit or miss the target.

 Any Animal symbols on the reels that are hit are transformed into Coin or Trap symbols. Animal symbols display between 1 and 4 Stars, which determines the minimum currency revealed.

 1 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Bronze Coins.

 2 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Silver Coins.

 3 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Gold Coins.

 4 Star Animal symbols transform into a Trap symbol with a minimum value equal to Gold Coins.

 All Coins are awarded as a multiple of your bet amount.

 Bronze Coins have the following starting values: 0.2x, 0.4x, 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x

 Silver Coins have the following starting values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x

 Gold Coins have the following starting values: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 Diamond Coins have the following starting values: 100x, 150x, 250x, 500x

 During a Hunt, when a 4 Star Animal symbol appears on a reel that is shot, that symbol will transform into a Trap symbol with a value. Trap symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Trap symbols and add the collected values to its existing Trap value. All collected symbols retain their original values when collected by a Trap symbol. Trap symbols activate top to bottom, left to right. The final win is the total value of all Coins and Trap symbols.

 If there is a Wild symbol on a reel that has been shot, that Wild symbol receives a Multiplier value. After all Coins and Trap symbols are collected each Wild symbol with a Multiplier multiplies between 1 and 5 Coin and Trap symbols. Wild symbols with Multipliers activate top to bottom, left to right. Wild symbols with Multipliers can have the following Multiplicative Multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 Only one Hunting Season symbol can land on the grid at a time.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Symbol wins make that symbol type enter a charged state and begin to glow. Charged symbol types are also shown in the “charge bar” display above the grid. Symbols retain their charged state until the end of the current spin.

 The Epic Gem scatter symbol may drop in on cascades after winning symbols are removed and will activate after the grid has settled, when no more wins or cascades occur. When the Epic Gem activates, all charged symbols on the grid are transformed into the highest paying charged symbol!

 All charged symbols are then absorbed by the Epic Gem and counted as if they were one winning cluster. The Epic Gem itself counts as 4 symbols, so that it will always be able to create a minimum win of 5 symbols so long as there is at least one charged symbol on the grid. Once all charged symbols are absorbed, the Epic Gem explodes and triggers another cascade!

 Symbols do not have a charged state during the Gem Hoarder game mode.

wilds.name: Gem Hoarder
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 Gem Bag scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus game, which has 5 refilling free spins. Landing 3 Gem Bag symbols at the same time during the feature refills all 5 free spins!

 This feature has a progressive global multiplier that increases whenever winning symbols are removed! The multiplier value is increased by an amount equal to the number of removed symbols. Any winning cluster that connects to the special X-Gem symbol is multiplied by the global multiplier! If more than one X-Gem symbol connect to the same winning cluster, the global multiplier will be applied once for each connecting X-Gem symbol!

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Epic Gem does not appear in the Gem Hoarder game mode.

 The X-Gem symbol counts as a wild symbol, substituting all other paying symbols, and appears only in the Gem Hoarder game mode.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: BURNING WILD SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When a Burning Wild symbol lands on the grid, it activates and burns all paying symbols and FS symbols on the reel above where the symbol landed.

 When low-paying symbols are burnt, they transform into Wild symbols.

 When high-paying symbols are burnt, they transform into Burnt Wild Multipliers. When Burnt Wild Multipliers are part of a win, the Multiplier value is added to all wins connected to that Burnt Wild Multiplier. If more than one Burnt Wild Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, the values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Burnt Wild Multipliers can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x

 Each high-paying symbol has its own corresponding Burnt Wild Multiplier.

specials.name: FS SYMBOLS
specials.behavior:
When 3 or more FS symbols land simultaneously, each FS symbol will display a free spin value. The total number of free spins awarded for the bonus is determined by adding up all the numbers on positions covered by each FS symbol. FS symbols can have the following values: 2 - 5.

 When FS symbols are burnt, they can display a higher free spin value. Burnt FS symbols can have the following values: 3 - 6.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - GRUG FIND FOOD
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 6 - 18 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics with an increased chance of landing Burning Wild symbols.

 FS symbols can land with the following values: 1-3 and Burnt FS symbols can have the following values: 2 - 4.

 Landing an additional FS symbol in the bonus awards extra free spins: An FS symbol awards at least 1 free spin and max 4 free spins.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - GRUG FIGHT DINO
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the GRUG FIND FOOD bonus. In this bonus, a Wildfire Bar is located outside the grid. The Wildfire Bar has Levels and is progressive throughout the bonus. The Wildfire Bar will reach the next Level when a certain number of winning symbols have been awarded. Each Level will award a certain number of Burnt Reels. Once a new Level is reached, the Bar will reset. The Wildfire Bar starts at Level 0.

 12 winning symbols are needed to reach Level 1, which awards 1 Burnt Reel 
 46 winning symbols are needed to reach Level 2, which awards 2 Burnt Reels 
 96 winning symbols are needed to reach Level 3, which awards 3 Burnt Reels 
 150 winning symbols are needed to reach Level 4, which awards 4-5 Burnt Reels 

 Once Level 4 is reached, the Wildfire Bar will stay at Level 4 until the end of the bonus.

 Burnt Reels burn low and high-paying symbols and FS symbols on that reel, and transform them as in the base game. When a Burnt Wild Multiplier burns twice, the existing Multiplier value will be multiplied by x3. If a Burnt FS symbol burns twice, its free spin value can increase to a higher value. The new possible values are: 3 - 5.

 When Burning Wild symbols and Burnt Reels are active at the same time, Burning Wild symbols activate first, followed by Burnt Reels. Any wins are awarded and the Wildfire Bar fills. Burnt Reels can only burn a reel once per spin.

 Landing an additional FS symbol in the bonus awards extra free spins: An FS symbol awards at least 1 free spin and max 5 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Burning Wild, Wild and Burnt Wild Multipliers substitute for all symbols in the paytable.

 Wild symbols only appear when transformed from a low-paying symbol.

 Only one Burning Wild symbol can land on the same reel.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

wilds.name: Soul Orbs
wilds.behavior: The base game contains two different Soul Orbs; one red and one blue. On each new round, there is a chance of landing either one or both Soul Orbs, or neither. Both Soul Orbs are Wild symbols that absorb power from all cluster wins in a round, with stacking multipliers that are applied to any win the Soul Orbs are a part of. The multiplier on the red Soul Orb increases by 1x for each symbol in every cluster win, while the multiplier on the blue Soul Orb increases by 1x per winning cluster. The multiplier resets on every new round. If both Soul Orbs connect to a winning cluster the multipliers on the Soul Orbs multiply each other.

multipliers.name: Underworld
multipliers.behavior:
10 free spins

 In this bonus feature all paying symbols from the base game appear together with a special green Soul Orb and a multiplier modifier symbol. This feature has multipliers below each reel. Multipliers are increased when winning clusters form, increasing by 1x for each winning symbol on the corresponding reels. The multipliers can also be multiplied by the multiplier modifier symbol.
The possible values for the multiplier modifiers are: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10.

 When the green Soul Orb symbol lands on a reel, the multiplier for that reel is activated. All activated multipliers are global. The value of all activated multipliers are added together and multiply the value of each winning cluster. Each time a multiplier is activated 3 additional spins are awarded. The maximum value per multiplier is 9999.

multipliers.name: Judgment
multipliers.behavior:
3 refilling spins

 In this bonus feature the symbols from the base game are replaced by special “block” symbols. This feature has multipliers above each reel. Multipliers are increased by landing Multiplier Modifier Blocks, which can be either adding or multiplying. There are Normal and Epic variants of both blocks, which affect either only the multiplier in the reel where they land, or all multipliers.
Adding modifiers values can be

Skull: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x
Epic Skull: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x

Multiplying modifiers values can be
Anubis Skull: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10
Epic Anubis Skull: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10

 When an ice block drops onto the grid, it will be crushed and a Multiplier Block will drop from the multiplier above the reel and fill the empty space. The value on each Multiplier Block is equal to the value of the reel multiplier where they drop. Multiplier Blocks fall to the bottom of the grid at the end of each drop, where they stick and stack on top of each other to gradually fill up the grid.

 There is also a special Crusher Block that falls through all other blocks to the bottom of the grid and destroys all Multiplier Blocks in its path to make room for new blocks to drop in. When the Crusher Block reaches the bottom of the grid, it transforms into a Multiplier Block with a value equal to the sum of all Multiplier Blocks that were destroyed by the Crusher Block.

 Every time a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block lands, the remaining spins reset to 3. When the bonus feature ends, the payout will equal the sum of all Multiplier Blocks times the bet level. 3 spins in a row without a Multiplier Block, Multiplier Modifier Block or Crusher Block ends the feature.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Every time you land a Seed symbol it will grow into a Sunflower symbol, so long as there are one or more winning positions on the grid. This symbol is wild and will get a starting multiplier value of 2x. Between each cascade and respin, this wild multiplier will hop to a new position. The maximum number of Sunflowers at the same time on the grid is 4.

If a multiplier is part of a winning cluster, the win will be multiplied by the value on the connecting multiplier. If 2 or more multipliers are part of the same winning cluster, they will first be multiplied by each other and then applied to the win amount.

Each winning cluster will then be removed to make way for more symbols. Activated Water Drops and Fertilizer (including Epic Fertilizer) are removed together with winning clusters. This will continue until no new winning clusters are created.

features.effects:

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
If two or more Hellhound symbols appear on adjacent reels and on the same row (horizontally adjacent) they form a Roaring Pack and their possible multiplier values are increased. Hellhound symbols which spread from a Hellhound that is part of a Roaring Pack will also be counted as part of the Pack.

 The possible multiplier values that can appear on Hellhound symbols that are part of a Roaring Pack are:

 Adding: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Multiplying: x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 If a Hellhound has been part of a Roaring Pack it will remain part of the Pack even if it is separated and ends up on a different row as a result of winning symbol cascades.

scatters.name: WHAT THE HELL!
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game retains the features of the base game but all multiplier values collected from Hellhounds are kept above the reels until the end of the round and can be progressively increased. At the end of the bonus game the collected multipliers are added together and multiplied with your bet to determine the final awarded win.

 In the bonus game, Hounds are Loose are guaranteed to trigger after 3 non-winning spins in a row. A spin is considered non-winning if it has neither regular symbol wins nor any landed Hellhound symbols.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards +2 free spins, 3 FS symbols awards +4 free spins.

scatters.name: WHO LET THE HOUNDS OUT?!?
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game retains the features of the base game and has persistent activated Hell Reels!

 This bonus also has the improved Hounds are Loose feature of the WHAT THE HELL! bonus.

 When a Hellhound lands on a reel for the first time that reel becomes an activated Hell Reel. A Hellhound symbol is guaranteed to land on each activated Hell Reel on each free spin until the end of the bonus.

 In this bonus, Hellhound multipliers are added together and paid out times your bet at the end of each free spin, and the total multipliers above each reel reset to 0 between spins.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards +2 free spins, 3 FS symbols awards +4 free spins.

multipliers.name: HELLHOUNDS
multipliers.behavior:
Hellhound symbols are cash prize multipliers that spread and are collected before being multiplied with your bet.

 At the end of each spin, landed Hellhound symbols spread to the top of their respective reel. All Hellhound symbols will then display a multiplier value. All multipliers will be collected bottom-to-top, left-to-right, and displayed above each corresponding reel.

 The collected multiplier values above each reel will be added together and multiplied with your bet to determine the final awarded win.

 There are two types of Hellhound symbols, Adding and Multiplying. Collected multipliers are either added to the current total at the top of the reel, or multiply the current total.

 The possible multiplier values that can appear on Hellhound symbols are: 

 Adding: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 Multiplying: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Only 1 Hellhound symbol can land on a reel at a time.

specials.name: HOUNDS ARE LOOSE
specials.behavior:
The Hounds are Loose can be triggered randomly on a spin once the grid is settled and no new wins are formed. When the Hounds are Loose appear, all low-paying symbols are removed and new symbols will drop in to take their place. Hounds are Loose can trigger multiple times per spin.

 After the Hounds are Loose clear away all low-paying symbols, there is an increased chance of landing Hellhound symbols among the new symbols that drop in.

specials.name: BONUS GAMBLE
specials.behavior:
Whenever you enter a bonus game, you have the choice to either continue directly to the bonus game or gamble. If you choose to gamble, you will be presented with 5 Hellfire Orbs to choose from.

 You can choose up to 3 Hellfire Orbs, with each Orb possibly containing 2 to 10 free spins, or a Bonus Upgrade if you are in the WHAT THE HELL! bonus. If a Bonus Upgrade is found, the bonus will be immediately upgraded to the WHO LET THE HOUNDS OUT?!? bonus with 10 free spins.

 You may gamble once per bonus and after a Bonus Upgrade.

wilds.name: DARK AWAKENING
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DARK AWAKENING bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 During this feature, only non-paying symbols, Awakened Multipliers and Coffin symbols appear. Above each reel is a multiplier value that can be increased by landing AWAKENED MULTIPLIER and COFFIN symbols. At the end of the feature, the multipliers above the reels will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final award.

 AWAKENED MULTIPLIER SYMBOLS

 Landed Awakened Multiplier symbols increase the value of the multipliers above the reels. They can be adding or multiplying and can affect one or all the reel multipliers.

 Normal multipliers only affect the reels they land on, while Epic multipliers are applied to all the reels.

 Normal adding multipliers can have the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

 Epic adding multipliers can have the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

 Normal Multiplying multipliers can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10.

 Epic Multiplying multipliers can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10.

 COFFIN SYMBOLS

 Coffin symbols are sticky until the end of the feature. At the end of the bonus game, landed Coffin symbols will reveal a multiplying multiplier which will be applied to their respective reel multiplier.

 Coffin symbols can have the following multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins;

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for other paying symbols in the paytable.

 Awakened Multiplier symbols and Coffin symbols only appear in the Dark Awakening bonus game.

multipliers.name: BLOOD REEL
multipliers.behavior:

The total win amount in each winning combination is multiplied by the sum of the multipliers included in that win to determine the final win value.

 For example, if a winning combination consists of 5 winning symbols of a certain type, of which 2 are on Blood Reels and both are given a multiplier of 10x, the total multiplier for that win will be 20x and the final win amount will be determined by counting the base win value for those 5 symbols times the multiplier of 20x.

 Blood Reels can add the following multiplier values to Vampire symbols: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 A Blood Reel always applies the same multiplier value to the Vampire symbols on the reel. Blood Reels may appear during the base game and Blood Moon bonus game. Maximum 5 Blood Reels can appear at the same time.

wilds.name: DUELREELS™
wilds.behavior:
When a VS symbol lands it will expand into a wild DuelReel if it would be part of a winning combination once expanded.

 After expanding, the DuelReel will cover the entire reel and a duel will take place on the reel. Each DuelReel will have two multipliers, connected to the duelists The Outlaw and The Sheriff. The surviving duelists multiplier will be applied across the entire reel and affects any winning combinations that includes the DuelReel.

 All expanded DuelReel positions count as WILD symbols

 The possible multiplier values for DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x

 If more than one DuelReels™ are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 Only 1 VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

wilds.name: THE OUTLAW FEATURE
wilds.behavior:
When an Outlaw symbol lands, it will expand into a full wild Outlaw reel and show a revolver with 1-6 bullets in its chambers. The number of bullets in the revolver represents the number of Wild symbols that the Outlaw will shoot onto the grid.

 If more than one Outlaw is on the grid at the same time, they cannot shoot multiple Wild symbols onto the same positions on the grid, nor can they shoot at each other. A maximum of 2 Outlaw symbols can appear on one spin, and only 1 Outlaw symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 Each Outlaw reel will also have a multiplier that can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x.

 The multiplier affects any winning combination that includes the Outlaw reel. If more than one Outlaw reels are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: WILD WILD WEST
wilds.behavior:

 This bonus feature maintains the mechanics of the base game with an increased chance of getting high-value multipliers on DuelReels™ and Outlaw reels! There is also an increased chance of landing VS symbols and Outlaw symbols!

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

wilds.name: DUSK ‘TIL DAWN
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DUSK ‘TIL DAWN bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus feature offers the chance of earning 4 DuelSpins with guaranteed VS symbols! You unlock each DuelSpin by landing Outlaw symbols and shooting a full revolver of 6 Wild symbols onto the grid.

 Each DuelSpin is awarded immediately after the free spin where you unlocked it and does not count towards your number of free spins in the bonus. No more than 2 DuelSpins can be unlocked in one spin; if more than one are unlocked in the same spin, they are awarded in sequence before proceeding to the next free spin.

 Each subsequent DuelSpin awards more guaranteed VS symbols:

 The first DuelSpin guarantees at least 2 VS symbols;

 The second DuelSpin guarantees at least 3 VS symbols;

 The third DuelSpin guarantees at least 4 VS symbols;

 The fourth DuelSpin guarantees that 5 VS symbols land!

 Each unlocked DuelSpin also awards 3 additional free spins.

 VS symbols do not appear in this bonus except during DuelSpins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 A VS symbol and an Outlaw symbol can never land at the same time.

respins.how_it_works:
EchoSpins™ are a special type of respins where each spin is a copy of the original triggering spin. When the Hand of Jupiter symbol lands together with at least one winning payline, it reveals the number of EchoSpins™ awarded for that phase. Between 1 - 8 EchoSpins™ can be awarded by the Hand of Jupiter.

 Each respin then repeats all the wins and multipliers from the spin before, stacking multipliers progressively in the total multiplier value on top of the reels before applying the new total multiplier value to all winning paylines on the spin.

The multipliers that land on the reels can be either additive or multiplicative. Multipliers are not applied to any wins except during EchoSpins™.
Additive multipliers can be: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x
Multiplicative multipliers can be: x2, x3

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
During each round all wins will be collected and displayed above the reels as a pending win amount. That amount will be updated after every spin/cascade that awards a new win. If you land one or more multiplier bombs their values will be added together and stored as a pending win multiplier that is applied to the total win at the end of each round. All multiplier bombs act as scatter symbols.

There are three types of multiplier bombs:

 NORMAL BOMB

 Will land with the multiplier value visible, explodes and adds the multiplier value to the pending win multiplier. Possible values: 2x, 3x and 4x

 REVEALING BOMB

 Will land with a ?-character, explodes and adds the multiplier value to the pending win multiplier. Possible values are: 5x, 10x, 25x and 50x

 EPIC BOMB

 Will land with an X-character, explodes and multiplies the pending win multiplier with the value shown. Possible values are: x2, x3, x4, x5 and x10

 The normal and revealing bombs will only explode and add their multiplier values to the win multiplier if a win has occured on the current spin and there is a pending win above the reels.

The epic bombs will only explode to multiply an existing pending win multiplier.

scatters.name: COCKTAIL GLASS SYMBOL
scatters.behavior:
When a winning combination appears while the Cocktail Glass scatter symbol is on the grid, all symbols of the winning type are re-frozen to the fully frozen state. More than one symbol type can be re-frozen at the same time.

 The number on the Cocktail Glass shows the number of remaining re-freezes that can occur, which starts at a maximum of 5. The Cocktail Glass is removed on the next symbol removal after the last re-freeze.

scatters.name: BLENDER SYMBOL
scatters.behavior:
When the Blender scatter symbol lands it activates and chooses one type of symbol to absorb.

 All symbols of the chosen type are absorbed by the Blender and new symbols drop in to replace them. This continues until there are no more symbols of the chosen type.

 At the end of the spin the Blender will award a prize equivalent to a cluster of the absorbed amount of symbols. Please refer to the paytable to see the possible awards for different cluster sizes. The Blender always starts with a count of 2 symbols and adds 1 to its counter for each absorbed symbol.

specials.behavior:
All paying symbols have one of three states: fully frozen, half-frozen or unfrozen.

 Every time that a winning combination is awarded, the unfrozen symbols that were part of that winning combination are removed. After all winning combinations have been awarded, all unfrozen symbols on the grid are removed regardless of whether they were part of a winning combination or not.

 Symbols that are fully frozen or half-frozen are not removed from the grid, even if they were part of a winning combination.

 Symbols that were not removed instead change state: symbols that were fully frozen become half-frozen and symbols that were half-frozen become unfrozen.

 New symbols then drop in to replace the removed symbols. This continues until there are no more winning combinations on the grid.

modes.name: SUNSET PICNIC BONUS GAME
modes.effects:
Picnic Basket scatter symbols that land during a base game round are collected in the meter next to the grid.

 If a total of 3 Picnic Basket symbols land in the same base game round, the Sunset Picnic bonus feature is activated and awards 9 - 15 free spins. Each Picnic Basket symbol will reveal a number from 3 to 5. The number of awarded free spins is equal to the sum of the revealed numbers.

 During this bonus feature there is a higher chance of landing the Cocktail Glass and Blender symbols.

 Landing additional Picnic Basket symbols during the feature awards 2 to 5 extra free spins per landed Picnic Basket.

scatters.behavior:

 If more than one GET’EM symbol lands on the grid, each one will collect all the Cash symbols on the grid once.

 The collected Cash prizes are added together and displayed in the Total Win bar. At the end of the round, the Total Win is multiplied by your bet to form the final win.

scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 Throughout this bonus, there is an increased chance of landing GET’EM symbols, FS symbols and Cash prizes!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

 4 FS symbols award 6 extra spins.

scatters.name: KEEP YOUR FRIENDS CLOSE…
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this bonus game, landed Cash prizes stay on the grid until they are collected by a GET’EM symbol. Both the collected Cash prizes and the GET’EM symbol will spin out at the start of the next spin.

 Whenever there is a full row or a full reel of Cash prizes on the grid, the row or reel will automatically collect, even if there is no GET’EM symbol on the grid, and spin out at the start of the next spin. If there are one or more GET’EM symbols on the grid, they will also collect the Cash prizes separately.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

 4 FS symbols award 6 extra spins.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

 4 FS symbols award 6 extra spins.

scatters.name: LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL bonus feature with 10 free spins. This bonus feature retains the mechanics of the base game, and there is an increased chance of landing high multipliers!

 The bonus feature has a special Bounty Balloon that duplicates all applied multipliers from the total win bar!

 During the bonus all activated multipliers that are added to the Total Win Bar are also stored in a Bounty Balloon outside the grid. The multiplier amount in the Balloon grows until you pop it by landing an Epic Needle Box! Once popped, the multiplier amount stored in the Balloon will be added to the Total Win Bar multipliers and the Balloon will respawn and start collecting multipliers again!

 The multiplier value in the Bounty Balloon in LESTER’S CASH CAROUSEL will reset to 0 at respawn, ready to grow again!

 The bonus game also features Epic Needle Boxes. Landed Epic Needle Boxes clears all low- and high-paying symbols on the grid and pops the Bounty Balloon, instantly combining the effects of both Low- and High-Symbol Needle Boxes and awarding the Bounty Balloon multiplier!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 extra spins;

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

scatters.behavior:

 The Bounty Balloon in JESTER’S JACKPOT will respawn with the previous multiplier value intact, ready to grow again!

 Multiplying Klown Multiplier symbols can land with an initial value of x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, or x20. The multiplier then multiplies the current multiplier in the Total Win Bar when it is activated.

multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Marked Squares.

 If there is a Rainbow symbol on the grid it will activate any Marked Squares after all winning combinations have been awarded. Activated Marked Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Bag of Gold or Four-Leaf Clover symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Coins and special symbols have been revealed, Four-Leaf Clover symbols will activate and multiply all Coins and Bag of Gold symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Bag of Gold symbols will activate after all Four-Leaf Clover symbols have activated. Bag of Gold symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Bag of Gold symbols and store their total value. Bag of Gold symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Bag of Gold on the current grid has activated, all other Marked Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats until no new Bag of Gold symbols appear. All Marked Squares are then removed.

 At the end of the spin all Coins and Bag of Gold symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

multipliers.name: GOLDEN SQUARES
multipliers.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Golden Squares.

 If there is a Rainbow symbol on the grid, it will activate any Golden Squares after all wins have been collected. Activated Golden Squares reveal Special symbols, which are either Bronze, Silver, or Gold Coin symbols and can also reveal Basket symbols, Green or Gold Clover symbols, and Jackpot Eggs symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Golden Squares have been revealed, the Clover symbols will activate. Green Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Baskets on adjacent squares with one of the following Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. Gold Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Baskets on the grid with one of the following Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 Once all Clover symbols have applied their Multipliers, Basket symbols will activate. Baskets collect the values of all Coins and other Baskets, storing their total value. Baskets activate top to bottom, left to right. Baskets will not collect Jackpot Eggs.

 When the last Basket symbol on the current grid has activated, all other Golden Squares will activate again to reveal new Special symbols, and the process above repeats. Once all reveals and activations have been completed, all Coins and Baskets will be added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

specials.name: JACKPOT EGGS
specials.behavior:
Jackpot Eggs can land on the grid or be revealed in the Golden Squares. Jackpot Eggs award four different Jackpot Egg prizes with a value based on your current bet. The four Jackpot Eggs are: 

 MINI: 10x

 MAJOR: 100x

 MEGA: 1 000x

 MAX WIN: 20 000x

 The current value of each Jackpot Egg is displayed outside the grid on the Sign. Jackpot Eggs that land during a spin will be activated if they land together with a Rainbow. When a Jackpot Egg is revealed in a Golden Square, it will be awarded once all Coins and Basket values have been awarded. Only one of each Jackpot Egg value can appear at the same time, so a maximum of 4 different Jackpot Eggs can land on one spin. The Jackpot Egg values will be combined before being awarded.

 Once all the wins and cash prizes have been awarded, all Special symbols and Golden Squares are removed from the grid for the next spin.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a winning Cluster occurs with a Wild symbol, the Wild symbol will transform into a Revolver Cylinder scatter symbol. The Revolver Cylinder will have between 2 and 6 available shots. The Revolver Cylinder will activate after all wins and cascades have been settled. When the Revolver Cylinder fires, it will hit as many symbols on the grid as there are shots in the Revolver Cylinder. If there is more than one Revolver Cylinder on the grid, they will activate in order, from top to bottom, left to right. Revolver Cylinders can shoot the same position more than once. Once the Wild symbol has transformed into a Revolver Cylinder, it is no longer Wild.

 The symbols that the Revolver Cylinder hits will reveal Special symbols: Coin scatter symbols, Diamond scatter symbols, Clover scatter symbols, Loot Bag scatter symbols, and Reload scatter symbols. After all shots have been fired, if a Reload symbol appears on the grid, it will activate and reload all the Revolver Cylinders with between 2 and 6 shots, revealing new Special symbols. If a Coin symbol gets shot again by a Revolver Cylinder, that Coin symbol will be upgraded to the next Coin type. If a Green Clover symbol gets shot again by a Revolver Cylinder, it will be upgraded to a Gold Clover symbol. Diamonds, Gold Clovers, Loot Bags, and Reload symbols cannot be shot again.  Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

wilds.name: LAYERS
wilds.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs, the win is handled. Then, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, including one Layer of the grid behind those symbols. A new Layer appears and new symbols fill the empty spaces. This process continues until there are no more wins.

 The grid has 3 Layers, each Layer can have the following symbols:

 Layer 1: Low-paying, high-paying, Wild Dynamite and FS symbols. 
 Layer 2: Low-paying, high-paying, Wild Dynamite and FS symbols. 
 Layer 3: Golden reveals with Special symbols.

wilds.name: DYNAMITE REMOVAL
wilds.behavior:
After the grid has settled, there is a chance that Smokey will throw 1-5 Dynamites onto the grid.

 When Dynamite lands on the grid, it affects a 2x2 square around where the Dynamite landed. The affected symbols are removed, including one Layer behind the symbol. A new Layer appears and new symbols fill the empty spaces.

 When Smokey throws a Dynamite that affects a Wild Dynamite symbol, the Wild Dynamite will explode, removing symbols and one Layer in a 3x3 square around that Wild Dynamite symbol. This can cause a chain reaction if another Wild Dynamite symbol is within the 3x3 area, which in turn explodes and removes symbols and a Layer. If any two Dynamites affect the same position, only one Layer of the grid is removed. 

 If new regular wins are created, there is a chance that Smokey throws more Dynamite onto the grid. This can continue until no more regular wins occur.

 FS symbols and Layer 3 cannot be affected by thrown Dynamite or Wild Dynamite.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - GOLD DIGGER
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the base game's mechanics. In this bonus, Smokey is guaranteed to throw 5 Dynamites onto the grid once on every free spin after all regular wins have been handled. When all the Dynamite has exploded, new wins and any Golden reveals are handled. On Golden reveals, Coins will be Silver, Gold and Diamond.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild Dynamite symbols substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

multipliers.name: GOLDEN REVEALS
multipliers.behavior:
When Layer 3 is reached, those Golden positions reveal Special symbols when all regular wins and Dynamite have been handled. Special symbols are either Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond Coin symbols and can also reveal Collector symbols and Green or Gold Clover symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 20x, 30x, 40x, 50x 
 Diamond Coins can have the following values: 100x, 150x, 250x, 500x 

 After all Golden positions have been revealed, the Clover symbols will activate. Green Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Collectors on adjacent squares with one of the following Multiplicative Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. Gold Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Collectors on the grid with one of the following Multiplicative Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 Once all Clover symbols have applied their Multipliers, Collector symbols will activate. Collectors collect the values of all Coins and other activated Collectors and store their total value. Collectors activate top to bottom, left to right.

 After a Collector activates, all collected Golden positions will reveal new Special symbols, and the process above repeats for each Collector on the grid.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed, all Coins and Collectors will be added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

When a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Golden Squares.

 When a Rainbow symbol lands on the grid, it activates any Golden Squares after all wins have been collected. Activated Golden Squares reveal Special symbols that are either Bronze, Silver, Gold or Diamond Coins and can also reveal Green or Gold Clover symbols and Bucket or Global Bucket symbols.

 When an Epic Rainbow symbol lands, it reveals Special symbols on all positions on the grid. The reveal and activation process is the same for both Rainbow symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x

 Diamond Coins can have the following values: 150x, 250x, 500x

 After all Golden Squares have been revealed, the Clover symbols will activate. Green Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Bucket and Global Bucket symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following Multiplicative Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. Gold Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Bucket and Global Bucket symbols on the grid with one of the following Multiplicative Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. If there are no Special symbols near the Clover symbols, they will activate once there are Special symbols on the grid to multiply.

 Once all Clover symbols have applied their Multipliers, Bucket symbols will activate. When Bucket symbols activate, they collect the values of all Coins and other activated Bucket and Global Bucket symbols on adjacent 3x3 squares and store their total value. Bucket symbols activate top to bottom, left to right.

features.name: BONUS GAME - ON THIN ICE
features.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
features.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the base game's mechanics, and all Golden Squares are progressive and will remain on the grid until either Rainbow symbol activates them. In addition, a Big Catch Bar is displayed outside the grid. Each time an FS symbol lands on the grid, the Big Catch Bar increases one step.

 When a Rainbow symbol has activated, it will transform into another Special symbol depending on the Level reached. The Big Catch Bar begins at Level 0, where the Rainbow symbol functions as usual. After every 5th FS symbol has landed, a new Level is reached on the Big Catch Bar:

 Level 1: After either Rainbow symbol activates, it transforms into a Green Clover symbol.

 Level 2: After either Rainbow symbol activates, it transforms into a Global Bucket symbol.

 Level 3: After either Rainbow symbol activates, it transforms into a Gold Clover symbol.

 Level 4: A Rainbow or Epic Rainbow symbol is guaranteed on every free spin, and after a Rainbow symbol activates, it will transform into a Gold Clover symbol.

 For every Level that is reached on the Big Catch Bar, +5 free spins are awarded.

features.name: BONUS GAME - SLIPPERY WHEN WET
features.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
features.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the ON THIN ICE bonus. In addition, all Golden Squares are progressive and stay on the grid throughout the bonus, even after being activated by a Rainbow symbol. When Epic Rainbow symbols activate, only the Golden Squares that were on the grid before will remain after the full grid activation is complete. The minimum Coin value is 1x.

 For every Level that is reached on the Big Catch Bar, +5 free spins are awarded.

features.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - SMOKEY UNDER WATER
features.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the SLIPPERY WHEN WET bonus and the Big Catch Bar starts at Level 4 and remains there for the entire bonus.

 FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 FS, Rainbow and Epic Rainbow symbols cannot land at the same time.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Armed with his orange floaties and yellow wellies, Smokey hits the water! He might be looking to put the heists on hold for a weekend and take a relaxing break away, but we know this Frenchie better than that. He isn’t just fishing for dinner; rumor has it there’s some treasure at the bottom of this lake, and if anyone can catch it, it’s Le Fisherman!

 So if you’re hanging out by the lake this weekend, you might spot him air-jamming with his fishing pole, singing to himself: “Smokeeey on the waaater, duh duh duuuh, duh duh duh duuduuh!”

 Tag along on this 6-reel, 5-row game

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Any time a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination will also be removed from the grid and new ones will drop down to fill the empty spaces.

scatters.name: LUCK OF THE FAN
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 8 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus all Marked Squares remain highlighted between spins until they are activated by the Rainbow symbol.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards extra free spins: 2 FS awards +2 free spins, 3 FS awards +4 free spins.

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time upgrades the bonus to the All That Glitters Is Gold bonus and awards +4 free spins.

scatters.name: ALL THAT GLITTERS IS GOLD
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 12 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus all Marked Squares remain highlighted throughout the whole bonus, even after being activated by the Rainbow symbol.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards extra free spins: 2 FS awards +2 free spins, 3 FS awards +4 free spins.

scatters.name: TREASURE AT THE END OF THE RAINBOW
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 12 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 In this bonus all Marked Squares remain highlighted throughout the whole bonus, even after being activated by the Rainbow symbol. A Rainbow symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin in this bonus.

 In addition, Bronze Coins do not appear in this bonus.

multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Marked Squares.

 If there is a Rainbow symbol on the grid it will activate any Marked Squares after all winning combinations have been awarded. Activated Marked Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Bucket of Gold or Four-Leaf Clover symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Coins and special symbols have been revealed, Four-Leaf Clover symbols will activate and multiply all Coins and Bucket of Gold symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Bucket of Gold symbols will activate after all Four-Leaf Clover symbols have activated. Bucket of Gold symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Bucket of Gold symbols and store their total value. Bucket of Gold symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Bucket of Gold on the current grid has activated, all other Marked Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats until no new Bucket of Gold symbols appear. All Marked Squares are then removed.

 At the end of the spin all Coins and Bucket of Gold symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - VIVA LE BANDIT!
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the JACKPOT OF GOLD mechanics. In addition, every spin guarantees 1 Neon Rainbow, and when Coins are revealed, they will always be Silver or Gold!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

multipliers.name: GOLDEN SQUARES
multipliers.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Golden Squares.

 If there is a Neon Rainbow symbol on the grid, it will activate any Golden Squares after all wins have been collected. Activated Golden Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver, or Gold Coins and can also reveal Treasure Pots, Green or Gold Clover symbols, and Jackpot Markers.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Golden Squares have been revealed, the Clover symbols will activate. Green Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Treasure Pots on adjacent squares with one of the following Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20. Gold Clover symbols will multiply all Coins or existing Treasure Pots on the grid with one of the following Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 Once all Clover symbols have applied their multipliers, Treasure Pot symbols will activate. Treasure Pots collect the values of all Coins and other Treasure Pots and store their total value. Treasure Pots activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right. Treasure Pots will not collect Jackpot Markers.

 When the last Treasure Pot on the current grid has activated, all other Golden Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed, all Coins and Treasure Pots will be added together and multiplied by your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADES
specials.behavior: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

specials.name: JACKPOT MARKERS
specials.behavior:
Jackpot Markers can land on the grid or be revealed in the Golden Squares. Jackpot Markers award four different jackpot prizes with a value based on your current bet. The four Jackpot Markers are:

 MINI: 10x

 MAJOR: 100x

 MEGA: 1 000x

 {maxJackpotLabel}: {highestJackpotMultiplier}x

 The current value of each jackpot is displayed outside the grid on the Jackpot Sign.

 Jackpot Markers that land during a spin will be activated if they land together with a Neon Rainbow. When a Jackpot Marker is revealed in a Golden Square it will be awarded once all Coins and Treasure Pot values have been awarded. Only 1 of each Jackpot value can appear at the same time, so a maximum of 4 Jackpot Markers can land on a spin. The Jackpot Marker values will be combined before being awarded.

 Once all the wins and cash prizes have been awarded, all Special Symbols and Golden Squares are removed from the grid for the next spin.

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: RAINBOW OVER THE PYRAMIDS
wilds.behavior:
Landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game awards the RAINBOW OVER THE PYRAMIDS Epic Bonus with 12 free spins!

 This bonus retains the Sticky Re-drops and Golden Riches mechanics from the base game.

 During this bonus, all Golden Squares remain highlighted until the end of the feature, even after being activated by a Rainbow symbol!

 In addition, a Rainbow symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins: 
2 FS awards +2 free spins; 
3 FS awards +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 The FS symbol does not appear in the LOST TREASURES or SUPER LOST TREASURES bonus games.

 The symbols in the paytable do not appear in the LOST TREASURES or SUPER LOST TREASURES bonus games.

 Stone Tablet symbols and dead symbols can only appear in the LOST TREASURES and SUPER LOST TREASURES bonus games.

scatters.name: BONUS CHOICE
scatters.behavior:
Landing 3 or 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game brings you into the Bonus Choice menu, where you are able to choose between two bonus game options depending on the number of landed FS symbols.

 With 3 FS symbols, you may choose either the LUCK OF THE PHARAOH or the LOST TREASURES bonus games.

 With 4 FS symbols, you may choose either the SUPER LUCK OF THE PHARAOH or the SUPER LOST TREASURES bonus games.

multipliers.name: GOLDEN RICHES
multipliers.behavior:
If there is a Rainbow symbol on the grid at the end of the Sticky Re-drops feature, it will activate the Golden Riches feature. When this happens, all Golden Squares on the grid will activate and reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show special Pot Of Gold, Green Clover or Golden Clover symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet. 
Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x 
Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x 
Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Coins and special symbols have been revealed, Clover symbols will activate. There are two types of Clover symbols: Green Clover and Golden Clover.

 Green Clover symbols multiply Coins or Pot Of Gold symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 Golden Clover symbols multiply all Coins or Pot Of Gold symbols on the grid with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 After all Clover symbols have awarded their multipliers, Pot Of Gold symbols will activate. Pot Of Gold symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Pot Of Gold symbols on the grid and store their total value. Pot Of Gold symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 When all values from Coins and Pot Of Gold symbols have been collected, all other Golden Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed, all Coins and Pot Of Gold symbol values will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

 Coins and special symbols are removed at the start of the next spin.

multipliers.name: LOST TREASURES
multipliers.behavior:
When you choose this bonus game from the Bonus Choice menu, you will enter the bonus with 3 refilling lives.

 The following symbols appear in this bonus: dead symbols, Coins, Green and Golden Clover, Pot Of Gold, and two different Stone Tablet symbols. Normal paying symbols do not appear. Dead symbols are non-paying and have no other effect.

 Each spin in the bonus consumes 1 life. Whenever any non-dead symbol lands, your lives are refilled to 3. After 3 spins without a refill, the bonus will end.

 All Coin symbols and Pot of Gold symbols that land become sticky until collected by a Pot Of Gold or the end of the feature.

 Stone Tablet symbols that land also become sticky until the end of the feature. There are two types of Stone Tablet symbols: Adding Stone Tablet and Multiplying Stone Tablet.

 The Adding Stone Tablet symbol adds a value to one random Coin on each spin, from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 The Multiplying Stone Tablet symbol multiplies the value of one random Coin on each spin, with one of the following multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20

 If the grid fills completely with Coins, Pot Of Gold, or Stone Tablet symbols, the bonus ends.

 At the end of the bonus game, all Coin and Pot Of Gold symbol values will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

specials.name: STICKY RE-DROPS
specials.behavior:
When a winning combination lands, the symbols in that combination will stick and a re-drop will be awarded. All paying symbols that stick in this way create Golden Squares on their positions.

 During the re-drop, paying symbols that either extend existing or create new winning combinations will also stick and another re-drop will be awarded. This continues until no further extensions or new winning combinations are created. Once no further re-drops are awarded, all wins will be paid out.

 Rainbow symbols and FS symbols that land together with a sticky winning combination will also stick but do not create Golden Squares.

 Sticky paying symbols are removed at the start of the next spin or when the Golden Riches feature activates.

 Golden Squares, sticky Rainbow symbols and sticky FS symbols are all removed at the start of the next spin.

specials.name: LUCK OF THE PHARAOH
specials.behavior:
When you choose this bonus game from the Bonus Choice menu, you will be awarded 10 free spins.

 This bonus retains the Sticky Re-drops and Golden Riches mechanics from the base game.

 In this bonus all Golden Squares remain highlighted until the end of the feature, even after being activated by a Rainbow symbol.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins: 
2 FS awards +2 free spins; 
3 FS awards +4 free spins.

specials.name: SUPER LUCK OF THE PHARAOH
specials.behavior:
When you choose this bonus game from the Bonus Choice menu, you will be awarded a variant of the LUCK OF THE PHARAOH bonus with an increased number of free spins! In this variant, 12 free spins will be awarded and there are better chances of landing the higher-value Coins and Pot Of Gold symbols.

 This variant guarantees that a Clover symbol is revealed whenever the Golden Riches mechanic activates!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time awards extra free spins: 
2 FS awards +2 free spins; 
3 FS awards +4 free spins.

specials.name: SUPER LOST TREASURES
specials.behavior: When you choose this bonus game from the Bonus Choice menu, you will be awarded a variant of the LOST TREASURES bonus. This variant guarantees that an Adding Stone Tablet symbol lands on the first spin. And there are better chances of landing higher-value Coins and Pot Of Gold symbols.

wilds.name: POSITION MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
When a Wild symbol is part of a win, the win will be handled before the position of the symbol will be marked as a x2 Position Multiplier. When a Position Multiplier is part of a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the shown Multiplier value. When multiple Position Multipliers are part of the same win, their values are multiplied before being applied to the win. Every time a Wild symbol in the same grid position as a Position Multiplier is part of a win, the value of the Position Multiplier is doubled. Position Multipliers are capped at x100.

 After all regular wins have been handled, Position Multipliers remain marked until the end of the spin, acting as Golden Squares.

wilds.behavior:
Trigger this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 FS, Rainbow and Epic Rainbow symbols cannot land at the same time.

multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Marked Squares.

 If there is a Rainbow symbol on the grid it will activate any Marked Squares after all winning combinations have been awarded. Activated Marked Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Bag of Gold or Four-Leaf Clover symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all Coins and special symbols have been revealed, Four-Leaf Clover symbols will activate and multiply all Coins and Bag of Gold symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Bag of Gold symbols will activate after all Four-Leaf Clover symbols have activated. Bag of Gold symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Bag of Gold symbols and store their total value. Bag of Gold symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Bag of Gold on the current grid has activated, all other Marked Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats until no new Bag of Gold symbols appear. All Marked Squares are then removed.

 At the end of the spin all Coins and Bag of Gold symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

modes.name: BERSERK FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 3 refilling lives.
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 3 refilling lives.

 The following symbols appear in this bonus: dead symbols, Coins, Diamonds, Green and Gold Clovers, Heart symbols, and Magic Cauldron symbols.

 At the start of the bonus, the positions of the FS scatter symbols that activated the bonus feature will be given Grid Multipliers with x2 multipliers. Grid Multipliers are sticky and stay in place until the end of the bonus feature.

 All Coins, Diamonds and Clover symbols that land become sticky until either collected by a Magic Cauldron or the bonus feature ends.

 When a Magic Cauldron symbol lands all Grid Multipliers and Clover symbols are activated and apply their multipliers to any Coins, Diamonds or previous Magic Cauldrons in their area of effect.

 Clover symbols behave the same as in Raid Spins and have the same multiplier values (see above), and may affect any adjacent Coins, Diamonds and Magic Cauldron symbols. Grid Multipliers affect any Coins or Diamonds on the corresponding grid position.

 All Coins, Diamonds, and previous Magic Cauldron symbols are then collected into the newest Magic Cauldron, which remains on the grid until it’s collected or the feature ends. Each Magic Cauldron symbol cannot collect more than once.

 Each spin in the bonus game consumes 1 life. Whenever any symbol that is not a dead symbol lands, your lives are refilled to the maximum amount. Once all lives are consumed, the bonus will end.

 Landing a Heart symbol increases your maximum number of lives in the current bonus game by 1, up to a maximum of 5.

 At the end of the bonus feature all Coins and Diamonds on the grid reveal a random cash value depending on the symbol type. These cash values are the same as in Raid Spins (see above).

 All Grid Multipliers and Clover symbols will then activate to multiply any Coins, Diamonds, or Magic Cauldron symbols in their area of effect.

 Finally, all Coins, Diamonds and Magic Cauldron symbol values will be added together to determine the final win amount for the bonus game.

wilds.name: Magic Piggy & Magic Hat
wilds.behavior:
The Magic Piggy symbol is a revealing symbol that reveals either a Wild symbol or a Bill Stack symbol when activated by the Magic Hat symbol! All Magic Piggy symbols reveal the same type of symbol.

 When the Magic Hat symbol lands, it first shows what all Magic Piggy symbols will reveal and then transforms into the revealed symbol. 

 Bill Stack scatter symbols are cash prizes based on your current bet. All Bill Stack symbols are added together and the total amount is multiplied by your current bet to produce the win amount.

 Bill Stacks can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500

 When revealing Bill Stack symbols, there is a chance that a Magic Piggy symbol instead reveals a Multiplier Coin scatter symbol.

 Multiplier Coins reveal a multiplier value, and then multiply 1 - 5 Bill Stack symbols with the revealed value. The same Bill Stack symbol can be affected multiple times by the same Multiplier Coin, or by different Multiplier Coins.

 Multiplier Coins can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5

wilds.name: Epig Bonus
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature, which awards 10 free spins!

 In this feature the Magic Piggy symbols will only reveal Bill Stack symbols or Multiplier Coin scatter symbols when activated by the Magic Hat symbol!

 The Epig Bonus game has progressive Piggy Points that do not reset after a Magic Hat trigger! See description of Pig Bonus above for other rules.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: Pig Bonus
scatters.behavior:

 In this feature the Magic Piggy symbols will only reveal Bill Stack symbols or Multiplier Coin scatter symbols when activated by the Magic Hat symbol!

 Land Star and Super Star scatter symbols to collect Piggy Points above the reels!

 Star symbols add 1 - 3 Piggy Points to the meter above the reel where it landed.

 Super Star symbols add 1 - 3 Piggy Points to all reels!

 When the Magic Hat symbol lands, an equal amount of Magic Piggy symbols will fill random positions on the corresponding reels.

 Piggy Points are reset after each Magic Hat trigger.

 Completely filling the Piggy Points meter above all reels at the same time awards 10 additional free spins!

 Landing 3 FS symbols at the same time in the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time in the feature instantly triggers the Epig Bonus. If the remaining number of free spins is less than 10, the remaining number of free spins will be set to 10. Otherwise, the current number of remaining free spins is unchanged.

 Fisherman symbols do not collect the value of other Fisherman symbols. A maximum of one Fisherman symbol can land on each reel at the same time.

WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - HOOKED ON PARADISE
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. During this bonus, Sticky Fisherman symbols can land, collecting Marlin symbols and remaining on the grid throughout the round. 1 Sticky Fisherman symbol will be on the grid from the start. Additionally, Sticky Golden Fisherman symbols can also land. These collect both Marlin symbols and Fisherman symbols, and they stay on the grid for the duration of the bonus.

 If a Sticky Golden Fisherman symbol is on the grid, no other Golden Fisherman symbols can land. At the end of the bonus, the values collected by all Sticky Fisherman symbols are paid out. Golden Marlin symbols that land will have a minimum value of 3x.

multipliers.name: FISHERMAN SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
When a Fisherman symbol lands, it collects all Marlin symbols on the grid. Each Fisherman symbol collects each Marlin symbol once and will activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right. Fisherman symbols activate after regular wins and LootLine wins have been awarded. Fisherman symbols can appear normal or Golden.

 The normal Fisherman symbols can land with a Multiplier value that affects the value of all the Marlin symbols it collects. The possible Multiplier values are: x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20. Once the Marlin symbols have been collected the Fisherman symbol will multiply the values to determine the final awarded win.

 If a Golden Fisherman symbol is on the grid, it will activate after all normal Fisherman symbols. The Golden Fisherman symbol collects all Marlin symbols on the grid and the collected values from the other Fisherman symbols on the grid. Only 1 Golden Fisherman symbol can appear at the same time.

 The total value of all Fisherman symbols on the grid is paid out at the end of the spin.

collectors.name: MARLIN SYMBOLS AND LOOTLINES
collectors.behavior:
Marlin symbols are dynamic paying symbols that display cash values and appear normal or Golden. The cash value shown on the symbol represents the payout that is awarded if the Marlin symbol is part of a LootLine or is Collected by a Fisherman. Normal and Golden Marlin symbols can have values based on the following bet Multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x, and 1000x.

 A LootLine is formed when there is a winning payline of Marlin symbols on the grid. The payout of the LootLine is determined by the values of the Marlin symbols that are part of the win. 

 When a Golden Marlin symbol is part of a LootLine win, the Golden Marlin activates and spreads its value to all normal Marlin symbols on the grid. The LootLine win is then awarded. If there are any other Golden Marlin symbols on the grid that were not part of a win, and a Fisherman symbol is present, they will then activate and spread their values to all normal Marlin symbols. Once all normal wins, LootLine wins, and Golden Marlin activations are complete, the Fisherman collects all Marlin symbols.

 If a Marlin symbol's value is too large to display fully, it will be shortened to two decimal places. The displayed value represents the minimum possible award, though the actual amount may be higher. For example, 10 250 500 may be shown as 10.25M.

 Welcome aboard Marlin Masters: The Big Haul, a 5-reel, 4-r

scatters.name: STACK SPINS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 In the Stack Spins feature you have a higher chance of landing Stackways™ symbols.

 Landing the Reel Activator scatter symbol activates the reel where it landed and guarantees that a Stackways™ symbol lands on that reel on each remaining free spin.

 Landing 3 Skull symbols at the same time during the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

scatters.name: MAYAN GOLD
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature.

 In the Mayan Gold feature your goal is to collect Coins and save their values above the reel where the Coins land.

 Bronze coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

 Silver coins can have the following values: 10, 15, 20

 Gold coins can have the following values: 25, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 500, 1000

 Landing a Multiplier symbol will multiply the number above the reel where it lands with the value on the Multiplier.

 Multipliers can have the following values: 2, 3, 4, 5

 Landing a Stackways™ symbol on a reel will fill that reel with a stack of Coins where each Coin takes on the value above that reel! Once a reel is stacked with Coins that reel is locked and no longer spins.

 Landing the Collect scatter symbol will collect all Coins on the currently locked reels and store the sum in the Vault below the reels. Collecting the Coins also unlocks the stacked reels!

 The feature ends when all five reels are simultaneously locked by stacked Coins. When the feature ends, the values of all stacked Coins and the value stored in the Vault will be added up and multiplied with your bet to determine the awarded prize.

scatters.name: A Golden Opportunity
scatters.behavior: Landing 5 Skull scatter symbols at the same time in the base game will start the Mayan Gold feature with a value of 50 above all reels. This cannot occur when buying the bonus Mayan Gold through the bonus buy feature.

specials.name: STACKWAYS™
specials.behavior:
Land the Stackways™ symbol on a reel to fill that reel with a stacked amount of paying symbols equal to the number displayed. Between 2 - 10 symbols can be stacked on each reel.

 The stacked symbol is chosen based on what symbol would create the longest winning way among the symbols present on the reels when the Stackways™ mechanic activates. If there are several symbols that would create equally long winning ways, it chooses randomly among these symbols. The stacking only occurs when the result of the stacking would create a win.
